This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Frontier Airlines is a Zero Tolerance Drug-Free Workplace. All prospective DOT safety-sensitive employees are subject to pre-employment testing for the following drugs and their metabolites: Marijuana, Cocaine, Amphetamines, Opioids and Phencyclidine (PCP). Further, any DOT safety-sensitive job applicant who is found to have tested positive on any required drug or alcohol test at a former employer will be considered ineligible for employment with Frontier.

description:
Who Should Apply

We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit:

•

Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design.

Role & Responsibilities

As an AI Code Trainer , you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains.

•

Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices.

•

Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts.

Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs.

Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency.

Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively.

Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines .

Why Join Us?

$50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity.

•

100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours.

How to Apply

title: Spanish Copywriter
description:
Overview

Translated is seeking a senior-level Spanish Copywriter to craft high-quality, engaging content for a leading global brand.

This strategic role requires proven creative agility, strong strategic thinking, and exceptional expertise in both transcreation and original copywriting to drive market impact in Spain. Weekly hourly retainer: 10-20 hours/week.

Key Responsibilities

• Master and consistently apply the brand’s tone of voice for the Spanishmarket to ensure cohesive, on-brand copy across all touchpoints.

• Lead the development of original and transcreated copy across key channels, including:

• Social media campaign assets

• Social post copy (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other local platforms)

• SEM content

• Display ads

• Product naming

• Collaborate closely with the in-country Localization Manager, Creative team, and Marketing team.

• Present creative concepts in live calls and facilitate productive discussions to refine and align on strategic direction.

• Ensure all creative outputs align with strategic objectives, audience insights, and brand voice guidelines.

• Attend VO sessions, guide talent during recording, and support the mixing process to ensure the final output reflects the intended creative direction and local market expectations.

Key Requirements

Creative & Strategic Excellence

• Proven ability to accurately interpret creative briefs and translate strategic objectives into compelling creative solutions.

• Ability to develop copywriting strategies grounded in research and insights, with a strong understanding of audience behavior and market context.

• Demonstrated flexibility in adapting tone and style based on feedback and evolving business needs.

• Track record of exploring multiple creative directions beyond the first idea.

• Ability to confidently present and articulate in English the rationale behind the copy during live calls with XFN stakeholders, providing clear and persuasive explanations for creative and linguistic choices.

Speed & Efficiency

• Highly responsive during working hours and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

• Consistently meets tight deadlines without the need for repeated follow-ups.

• Efficient in producing multiple creative options without compromising quality.

Experience

• Extensive experience in transcreation and conceptual copywriting.

• Strong portfolio showcasing high-impact brand work.

• A presentation of the portfolio will be part of the interview process.

• Agency background required.

• Mid- to Senior level experience required, with 5+ years of professional copywriting experience.

Collaboration & Mindset

• Proactively contributes ideas and acts as a confident cross-functional partner in creative discussions, rather than relying solely on direction.

• Open to feedback and able to iterate thoughtfully and strategically, minimizing the need for rework from stakeholders.

• Strong alignment with established team processes and expectations.

• Takes full ownership of delivering complete, polished creative solutions.

Languages

• Native-level Spanish

• Excellent English (written and spoken)

Location

• Remote, based in Spain

Success in This Role

• Consistently delivers thoughtful, on-brief creative work.

• Demonstrates strong adaptability and integrates feedback effectively.

• Brings fresh ideas and multiple creative perspectives to every brief.

title: Software Engineer - Developer Experience
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.

About the role

In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.

Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.

What you’ll be doing

• Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:

• Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them

• Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them

• Automating processes where manual processes exist.

• Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

• Managing access to key infrastructure.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.

• Automate local development workflows.

• Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.

• Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.

• Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.

• Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.

• Actively participate in code reviews.

What we’re looking for

• B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field

• 1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems

• Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.

• Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.

• Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go

title: Analyst II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics)
description:
At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Analyst at Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement.
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

What you'll do

•

Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

•

Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting

•

Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions

•

Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products

•

Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)

•

Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.

What we look for

•

3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role

•

Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization

•

Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)

•

Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality

•

Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability

•

Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business

•

Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products

•

Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution

•

Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 3

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents ). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role.

ESP base pay range per year: 63,000 - 99,000 EUR

Additional benefits include:

• Type of employment: Contract of Employment

• Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle

• Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge

• Learning & Development programs

• Parental benefits

• Employee Resource & Community Groups

This role is eligible for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law and company policy

Location - Remote Spain

The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Spain.

**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

• Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
At Catawiki , every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.
We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.
Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.
Taking ownership and driving impact
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers.
Important Notice: While we don't currently have an immediate opening for a Backend Engineer in Portugal, we're proactively building a talent pipeline for future opportunities. If your profile aligns with what we're looking for, we'd love to consider you as new positions become available.
Your Mission
On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.
We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer , you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand , Supply , or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.
What You'll Do
You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.
Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.
Own what you deliver , taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.
Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.
Improve how we work , identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.
Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.
Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.
Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.
What You'll Bring
You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.
Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.
Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.
Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.
API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.
Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.
Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.
Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.
Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.
How We Work
Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.
Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.
Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.
We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.
Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.
Where You'll Be
This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week.
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal . As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.
In Return
You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.
A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.
Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.
A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.
Why You'll Love Working with Us
Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.
Our Offices and Way of Working
Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.
Interested?
Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Software Developer, Mobile Platform
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Engineering talent to match.

You'd be joining our Mobile team within the Platform Engineering division. We treat our internal developer platform as a real product, with internal customers (our feature teams, 150+ developers) and adoption metrics.The mission for this role: make it dramatically faster and safer to ship mobile features at MaintainX.

Today, feature teams reinvent patterns, fight with build infrastructure, and ship slower than they should because the foundations underneath them are inconsistent. We want a mobile foundation where feature teams stop thinking about CI, release trains, shared components, and observability, they just build features.

What you’ll do:

•

Design, build, and maintain mobile React Native foundations and tooling powering our internal developer platform.

•

Bring AI native workflows into your daily work and into the platform.

•

Raise engineering excellence standards.

•

Lead to the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: SDKs, CI pipelines, build tools, local development golden paths.

•

Collaborate with other platform teams and product development teams on defining and adopting the internal developer platform.

About you:

•

4+ years of mobile engineering experience

•

Expert in React Native

•

Proficient building shared modules, SDKs, and reusable components for cross-team use.

•

Strong understanding of Mobile DevOps

•

Strong AI mindset

•

An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the team

Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you'll do

• Architect, design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.

• Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.

• Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving.

• Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.

• Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.

• Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms.

You'll be great for this position if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field.

• +8 years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems.

• Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc.

• Excellent software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintenance in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting)

• Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse).

• Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithms optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation.

• Good understanding of data pipelines, APIs, containers (Docker), and version control (Git).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.

• You have working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp.

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team.

🚵🏾♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches.

About us:

SumUp is a leading financial technology company, founded in 2012 with the goal of empowering small businesses around the globe. We're the financial partner of choice for more than 4 million merchants in over 35 markets. We collectively build, plan and fine-tune the technology that drives SumUp and empowers small businesses around the world.

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their business. With a founders mentality and a 'team-first attitude' our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Marketing / Social Media / Erneuerbare Energien
description:
Einleitung

Wir sind die Solarfarm RE GmbH aus Mainz. Seit 2023 entwickeln wir bundesweit Photovoltaikfreiflächenanlagen und Batteriegroßspeicher, von der ersten Flächenidee bis zur Baureife. Unser Team ist mittlerweile rund 15 Köpfe stark, wir arbeiten mit namhaften Partnern zusammen und haben in kurzer Zeit eine Projektpipeline im Gigawattbereich aufgebaut.

Was uns bisher fehlt, ist ein Auftritt nach außen, der zeigt, was hier jeden Tag passiert. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du baust unseren Social Media Auftritt und unseren Blog mit auf, hast bei deinen Themen den Lead und siehst direkt, was deine Ideen bewirken. Bei uns gibt es keine langen Dienstwege, du sitzt mit den Leuten am Tisch, die die Projekte entwickeln, und holst dir deine Geschichten direkt von ihnen.

Aufgaben

Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unseren Marketingauftritt auf, und zwar hands on. Konkret erwartet dich:

•

Ausbau unseres Social Media Auftritts (insbesondere LinkedIn und Instagram): Du überlegst dir Themen und Formate, planst Beiträge, filmst und fotografierst selbst und schneidest kurze Videos. Vor der Kamera stehen unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen, du hast den Lead hinter der Kamera und bei der Umsetzung

•

Ausbau unserer Website mit Blogartikeln, zum Beispiel zu neuen Projekten, Meilensteinen, Partnerschaften und Hintergrundthemen rund um Solarparks und Batteriespeicher

•

Einbringen eigener Ideen: Neue Formate, Kanäle und Kampagnen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden bei Erfolg auch umgesetzt

•

Gestaltung von Werbemitteln wie Präsentationen, Flyern, Projektexposés und Unterlagen für Eigentümer, Kommunen und Investoren

•

Unterstützung unseres Marketing und Vertriebs im Tagesgeschäft, zum Beispiel bei Eigentümeransprache und Messeauftritten

•

Organisation und Versand von Briefen und Mailings an Grundstückseigentümer und Partner

•

Kennenlernen des gesamten Teams und unserer Organisation: Du erhältst Einblick in Projektentwicklung, Flächenakquise, Netzanschluss und Vertrieb und verstehst, wie ein Projekt von der Fläche bis zum Verkauf entsteht

Qualifikation

•

Du bist eingeschrieben im Studium der Kommunikationswissenschaft, Medienwissenschaft, Marketing, BWL mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Mediendesign oder einem vergleichbaren Fach und absolvierst ein Pflichtpraktikum laut Studienordnung

•

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media, Bildsprache und Storytelling und weißt, was auf LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert

•

Erste Erfahrung mit dem Filmen und Schneiden von Videos (zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere Pro oder vergleichbaren Tools) sowie mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus

•

Du schreibst gerne und sicher, auch längere Texte für Blog und Website

•

Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Lust, Dinge einfach auszuprobieren

•

Interesse an Erneuerbaren Energien und der Energiewende

•

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

•

Verfügbarkeit in Mainz für mindestens zwei Monate

Benefits

•

Echte Verantwortung statt Kaffeekochen: Du hast bei deinen Themen den Lead, und deine Beiträge gehen tatsächlich online

•

Viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen und die Chance, einen Marketingauftritt von Grund auf mitzugestalten

•

Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege

•

Modernes Büro mitten in der Mainzer Altstadt, gut erreichbar mit Bahn und Rad

•

Einblick in den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess von Solar und Batteriespeicherprojekten

•

Flexible Arbeitszeiten

•

Kostenlose Getränke, gemeinsame Mittagspausen und regelmäßige Teamevents

•

Sehr gute Chance auf eine anschließende Werkstudentenstelle oder eine Abschlussarbeit bei uns

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, den gewünschten Zeitraum und den Nachweis über dein Pflichtpraktikum. Wenn du schon Beiträge, Videos oder Texte gemacht hast, zeig sie uns gerne, ein Link zu deinem Kanal oder ein kleines Portfolio sagt uns mehr als ein Anschreiben. Wir melden uns schnell zurück. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure)
description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure to join our fast-growing Network. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we’re looking for:

• 5+ years in Data Engineering roles.

• Advanced SQL knowledge: complex queries, performance tuning, stored procedures.

• Strong understanding of Azure technologies: Azure SQL Database, Data Factory, etc.

• Proven experience in ETL development, data integration, and pipeline orchestration.

• Deep understanding of data modeling principles and data warehouse architectures.

• Knowledge of data governance principles, data quality management, and data security best practices.

• Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-have:

• Familiarity with Azure Synapse Analytics, Data Lake, and Azure DevOps.

• Expert in Power BI development, including Power Query, DAX, and Power BI Service.

• Experience with Python or other scripting languages for data processing.

• Git or other version control systems for collaboration and CI/CD practices.

• Microsoft certifications (Power BI, Azure Data Engineer, or SQL Server).

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop end-to-end data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, SQL, and other Azure services.

• Implement complex data models, DAX measures, and calculated columns to support reporting.

• Manage and optimize ETL workflows, ensuring data quality, consistency, and high performance.

• Design and maintain data warehouses and dimensional models (e.g., star/snowflake schema).

• Collaborate with analysts, developers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Integrate data from various sources, including SQL databases, cloud storage, APIs, and flat files.

• Ensure data governance, accuracy, and integrity across the BI ecosystem.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies

Hand-picked opportunities, just for you

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

Headquarters: United States - Remote

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

We’re looking for a candidate who is passionate about healthcare, and providing independent healthcare practitioners the best single solution for delivering high quality care to patients. If you nerd out on positioning and messaging, love diving deep into market research and competitive intelligence, and think any time spent talking to customers is time well spent, this is the job for you. This role serves as the nexus of knowledge for EHR and care delivery products for the private practice market.

Your Area of Focus

• Conduct market research and analysis to identify customer needs, preferences, and trends

• Develop product positioning, messaging, and value propositions that resonate with target audiences

• Partner with product management to ensure that our products and services are meeting customer needs and delivering value

• Collaborate with the sales team to develop sales enablement materials, including presentations, demos, and case studies

• Make complex concepts easy to understand

• Analyze and report on key metrics, including customer acquisition, engagement, and retention

• Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices related to product marketing and healthcare to identify trends and emerging opportunities.

• Deliver weekly, monthly and quarterly competitive intelligence that draws on internal and external data, research and analysis and uses the voice of our customer.

Your Professional Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS preferred. Healthcare technology and EHR experience is a plus.

• Strong analytical and research skills with a proven track record in voice of the customer activities.

• Experience developing positioning and messaging for complex products in heavily regulated and competitive markets.

• Strong understanding of B2B and B2C marketing best practices

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager für Meta & Google Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Diese Stelle richtet sich an Leute mit echter Erfahrung. Du steuerst seit mindestens drei Jahren eigenverantwortlich Werbebudgets auf Meta und Google und hast zuletzt mindestens 50.000 Euro im Monat selbst verantwortet. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft und du Lust auf Tempo und Verantwortung hast, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens , weil wir im Team am schnellsten sind.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Performance unserer Kunden auf Meta und Google. Du entscheidest, wohin das Budget geht, was getestet wird und was skaliert. Du liest Zahlen so, dass du die Ursache findest und nicht nur das Symptom. Und du erklärst Kunden klar, was passiert und was als Nächstes kommt.

Konkret

• Du steuerst Meta- und Google-Ads-Konten für E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands, von der Struktur bis zur Skalierung.

• Du planst Budgets und Tests und entscheidest nach Profitabilität, nicht nur nach ROAS.

• Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative-Team und sagst, welche Creatives deine Konten als Nächstes brauchen.

• Du behältst Tracking und Datenqualität im Blick: Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions und GA4.

• Du führst Kundengespräche auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn die Zahlen mal schlecht sind.

• Du nutzt AI-Tools für Analyse, Reporting und Routine und gibst dein Wissen im Team weiter.

Dein Profil

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung von Meta und Google Ads.

• Du hast zuletzt Monatsbudgets ab 50.000 Euro selbst verantwortet.

• Du kennst E-Commerce- oder Leadgen-Konten aus der Praxis und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse nennen.

• Du verstehst Attribution, Tracking und Unit Economics gut genug, um Zahlen zu hinterfragen.

• Du kommunizierst klar, mit Kunden und im Team.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil du mit unseren Kunden sprichst.

• Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

• du Verantwortung für Ergebnisse willst und nicht nur für Aufgaben.

• du Entscheidungen mit Zahlen begründest.

• du im Team besser wirst und andere besser machst.

• du neugierig auf AI bist und sie im Alltag einsetzt.

Noch nicht passend ist die Rolle, wenn

• du gerade erst ins Performance Marketing einsteigst.

• du Kampagnen bisher vor allem nach Vorgabe umgesetzt hast.

Nice-to-have

• Erfahrung mit TikTok oder Pinterest Ads.

• Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo oder serverseitigem Tracking.

• Agenturerfahrung mit mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig.

Warum wir?

• Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: eigene Kunden, eigene Budgets, eigene Entscheidungen.

• Ein starkes Creative-Team im Haus, das liefert, was deine Konten brauchen.

• Eigene AI-Workflows für Analyse und Reporting, damit du Zeit für Strategie hast.

• Motiviertes High-Performance-Team, keine Politik, flache Hierarchien.

• Spannende E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).

• Benefitpaket mit Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen und Deutschlandticket.

• Modernes, zentrales Office am Gärtnerplatz in München.

• Team-Events, Workshops und Weiterbildungen.

Darauf schauen wir

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wichtig sind uns dein Lebenslauf und deine Antworten im Bewerbungsformular. Dort fragen wir nach deiner Erfahrung, deinem Budget und einem Konto, das du selbst gesteuert hast. Antworte bitte mit Zahlen.

Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese drei Angaben bitte in deinen Lebenslauf: Jahre Erfahrung, zuletzt verantwortetes Monatsbudget und ein Konto mit Ergebnis.

So geht es danach weiter: Videocall, eine kurze Case-Aufgabe, ein Probetag bei uns im Office mit persönlichem Gespräch, dann unsere Entscheidung.

title: Global Portfolio Coordinator
description:
The Global Portfolio Coordinator supports the execution of the Global Portfolio & Innovation agenda, ensuring high-quality portfolio data, structured governance, and clear executive reporting across Finance transformation initiatives.

This role sits at the intersection of data analysis, portfolio management, and executive support , enabling informed decision-making and consistent portfolio performance monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Portfolio Data & Reporting

• Consolidate and analyze portfolio data across multiple global initiatives

• Produce regular portfolio reports and performance insights

• Maintain and update Power BI dashboards for benefits tracking

• Provide data-driven recommendations to support decision-making

2. Portfolio Governance & Repository Management

• Manage the central portfolio repository (SharePoint / shared drives)

• Maintain governance templates, frameworks, and documentation

• Coordinate portfolio review cycles and prepare reporting materials

• Track actions and ensure follow-up with stakeholders

• Support onboarding of new initiatives into the portfolio

3. Benefits Tracking & Performance Monitoring

• Maintain benefits tracking across all initiatives

• Monitor planned vs. actual performance in collaboration with stakeholders

• Identify and escalate variances and risks

4. Executive Presentation Support

• Develop and refine executive-level presentations

• Structure clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders

• Iterate quickly based on leadership feedback

5. Process & Continuous Improvement

• Support the design and documentation of portfolio management processes

• Improve templates, tools, and governance practices

• Contribute to process optimization and innovation initiatives

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field

• 2–4 years’ experience in PMO, portfolio coordination, business analysis, or operations

• Experience in data analysis, reporting, and dashboard management

• Exposure to multinational or shared services environments

Skills & Competencies

•
Advanced Excel (data consolidation, financial tracking, analysis)

•
PowerPoint (executive-level presentations)

•
Power BI / data visualization (preferred)

• Strong financial and analytical mindset (budgets, forecasting, variance analysis)

• Structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities

• Strong stakeholder communication skills in a global environment

WHY JOIN THIS ROLE

• Exposure to global transformation initiatives (Finance 27+)

• Direct visibility to senior leadership and decision-making

• Opportunity to grow into PMO / Portfolio Manager or Transformation roles

Why SGS ?

• Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.

• Enjoy a flexible schedule and work model

• Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.

• Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

• Benefit from a comprehensive benefits platform.

Apply Now :
At SGS , we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries , supported by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals . With more than 145 years of service excellence , we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.

Our brand promise – “when you need to be sure” – underscores our commitment to trust, integrity and reliability , enabling businesses to thrive with confidence . We proudly deliver our expert services through the SGS name and a portfolio of trusted specialized brands , including Applied Technical Services , Brightsight , Bluesign and Nutrasource .

description:
Who are we?
At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.
We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.
We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.
Where does this role fit in?
We are looking for a dynamic, self-motivated, and ambitious strategic thinker with a successful track record to join our leadership team as a Manager of Account Management. This position will report to the Head of Customer Success, Americas. Our Account Management team is focused on driving revenue retention and expansion through renewals, cross-sells, and upsells for our highest-touch customers. We work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.
What will you do?
Build and lead a team of Account Managers focused on managing renewals, cross-sells, and upsells for high-touch customers
Scale, mentor, and develop a high-performing Account Management team
Accurately forecast monthly and quarterly revenue retention and expansion results
Drive strategy and build executive relationships for top accounts
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product) to optimize results and customer engagement
Use data and metrics to assess team performance and implement improvement initiatives
Ensure adherence to UpGuard’s post-sale processes and standards
Foster a culture of accountability and customer-first thinking within the team
Build close alignment with team leaders and individual contributors to support mentorship and career growth for high-performers
Develop and execute customer retention strategies, ensuring high customer satisfaction and long-term account stability.
What will you bring?
A minimum of 2 years of leadership experience managing Account Managers or similar post-sales teams, with a proven track record in revenue retention and expansion
At least 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS as an individual contributor, ideally with a focus on renewals, cross-sells, upsells, and a proven track record
Experience in leveraging post-sales technology stacks such as Hubspot (CRM) and Gong (Revenue Intelligence) to coach and guide your team
Demonstrated ability to plan, monitor, and optimize post-sale activities based on team performance and customer feedback
A problem-solver who simplifies complex challenges and fosters collaboration across teams
Leadership with an executive presence, capable of influencing at all levels
A customer-centric mindset, passionate about building and nurturing long-term relationships
A goal-oriented, collaborative approach that thrives on teamwork and diverse perspectives
What will give you an edge?
Familiarity with MEDDPICC sales methodology and process
Experience with cybersecurity and TPRM (Third-Party Risk Management) products
What's in it for you?
Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being
WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard
$1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance
Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.
18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role
Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave
Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance
Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role
Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.
Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.
UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!
As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.
Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

title: Head of Accounting (m/f/d) - Frankfurt am Main (hybrid)
description:
Your mission
The Head of Accounting is responsible for ensuring accurate and compliant accounting across all Matrix42 entities while leading and developing a team of accounting professionals. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, including general and sub-ledger activities, manages the month-end closing process and related analyses, supports the preparation of statutory financial statements, and drives continuous improvement within the accounting function.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing international accounting team across multiple locations, fostering professional growth and operational excellence.
Oversee the timely preparation of high quality consolidated financials statements on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis in accordance with IFRS.
Ensure the accurate and timely recording of journal entries, including revenue recognition in compliance with applicable accounting standards.
Support the preparation and submission of statutory financial statements, IFRS reporting packages, and audit deliverables for the group audit.
Drive the standardization and continuous improvement of accounting policies, controls, and processes across all Group entities.
Prepare and deliver financial reporting packages for banks, shareholders, investors, and other key stakeholders.
Act as primary point of contact for external auditors, tax advisors as well as other external and internal parties; especially Treasury, Tax and FP&A/Controlling
Manage and oversee the month-end closing process, including variance analysis and reporting
Ensuring the timely reconciliation and alignment of intercompany positions
Establish, maintain and continuously enhance audit guidelines & processes
Your profile
MUST HAVE
University degree in business administration or accounting
10+ years professional experience
3+ years of management experience with teams of 10-15 FTE spread across several locations in different countries
Experienced in preparing IFRS Group Financial Statements as well as stand-alone financial statements according to IFRS and HGB
Strong in VAT knowledge, Excel and in-depth knowledge of ERP systems
Strong analytical and communication skills
Ability to work with remote teams
Business Fluent in German and English (Finish or Polish or any other language will be a plus) NICE TO HAVE
Knowledge of LucaNet
Knowledge of Oracle NetSuite
Knowledge of another local GAAP
Our Benefits
We could tell you all about the free fruit and drinks in the office, that you will have flexible working hours, 25 -30 vacation Days (depending of the location) or that remote work is part of everyday life.
But in our eyes, that's not a benefit, it's standard. Here are some of our benefit offers:
Learning & Development Opportunities
- Up to 6 additional days off for personal or professional development
- Log into our online platforms to expand your knowledge or improve your language skills
One Social Day for you to assist in social settings or attend events which help improve our environment
Bicycle leasing, the contract and insurance will run through us
The possibility to choose an additional benefit that works for you either a fitness membership, jobticket, retirement plan or a monetary bonus
And many more... ask us about it!
Your contact person
Send us your application, including your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, directly through our online portal via the " APPLY NOW " button. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Birgit Busch .
We ask for your understanding that MATRIX42 can only accept applications online via the applicant portal in connection with our applicant management system due to the currently valid EU data protection regulations.

title: Senior Manager, AI Customer Success
description:
Headquarters: U.S. Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success to help us build and lead the Customer Success team for Source by Webflow, a new platform where marketing teams and their AI agents launch, optimize and scale digital experiences together. Source is in limited research preview today, and this team will support customers as it moves into commercial availability.

You’ll start as a player/coach, owning a small portfolio of strategic enterprise Source accounts, including renewals and growth. As Source adoption grows, you’ll build and scale the team. Your job is to help customers get agents into production, prove the business value, and turn that into retention and expansion. This is a first of its kind role for a first of its kind product. There is no playbook yet, and you will write it.

About the role:

• Location: Remote-first (United States)

• Full-time

• Permanent

• Exempt

• The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

• United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)

• Zone A: $204,000 - $255,000

• Zone B: $190,000 - $238,000

• Zone C: $177,500 - $222,000

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s market location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position i

title: (Senior) CRM Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Your Impact

At Juit, we enable our customers to eat healthy every day by delivering meals prepared by chefs directly to their homes. Our goal is to become the number 1 brand for healthy meals in Germany by providing our customers with the best online, meal, and delivery experience.

Our customers are already convinced - 4.8 out of 5 stars with over 20k reviews speak for themselves.

Support us in making healthy eating even easier and become (Senior) CRM Manager (m/f/d) at Juit.

As (Senior) CRM Manager (m/f/d), you will be part of the Marketing team and will be the interface to our community. In this role, you will promote continuous contact, provide inspiration, and set impulses to maintain the close relationship with our customers.

Your Responsibilities

• You continuously develop and optimize our CRM and Lifecycle Strategy.

• You build scalable Customer Journeys and Automations and further develop them.

• You are responsible for the CRM Roadmap and drive our Personalization and Segmentation Strategy.

• You develop new CRM initiatives to increase Retention, Customer Lifetime Value, and Loyalty.

• You work closely with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, BI, and Tech) to continuously optimize the Customer Experience.

• You establish a data-driven Test and Experimentation Culture within CRM.

Your Strengths

• You work self-directed, are extremely proactive, and possess the problem-solving competence to confidently master challenges.

• You think data-driven, can design analyses, and directly convert these insights into Business Decisions and Campaign Optimization.

• You master the planning, organization, prioritization, and implementation of multiple projects simultaneously.

• You work efficiently and independently, but are also a strong Team Player. You are open to feedback and consistently focus on the results.

• Your communication skills in German and English are excellent.

• You know how to seamlessly coordinate with other teams to optimize the CRM Strategy and all Marketing Activities.

Our Promise

• Impactful work in a growing company with development opportunities

• Committed team with talented and inspiring colleagues

• Well-organized onboarding and responsibility from day one

• A modern workplace

• Employee discount on Juit meals

Our Values

Apply now!

You want to be part of our team and help shape the future of Juit? Then apply now! We are looking forward to your application.

Please note, that for all applications a work permit in Germany is required!

About the Role

We're seeking a Designer to join Abnormal AI's Creative Services team. As a member of the in-house studio, you'll play a key role in bringing our visual identity to life across a wide range of touchpoints, including campaigns and digital surfaces to social, events, and brand content.

This is a hands-on execution role for a designer who is comfortable working across a broad spectrum of asset types and moving fluidly between projects. You care deeply about craft and quality, you're comfortable taking direction and running with it, and you thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. You bring a genuine curiosity for how AI tools can accelerate and elevate your creative process.

What You Will Do

• Produce high-quality design assets across brand touchpoints, including web, campaigns, social, events, and print.

• Execute creative across a variety of formats and asset types, working from briefs, established design systems, and creative direction.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, content, and web partners to deliver cohesive, on-brand creative.

• Contribute to web-forward creative execution across digital surfaces and campaigns, demonstrating fluency in how design systems translate to the web.

• Actively integrate AI tools into your creative workflow, using them to accelerate production, explore options, and push the work further.

• Maintain brand consistency across all deliverables, ensuring work aligns with Abnormal AI's visual identity standards.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing effectively and communicating proactively on timelines and capacity.

• 3–5 years of relevant design experience, ideally with a mix of in-house and agency backgrounds.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong craft across digital, brand, and campaign work, with clear evidence of web capability.

• Comfortable executing across a wide variety of asset types and moving fluidly between campaign, digital, brand, and web work.

• Web fluency: not necessarily a UI/UX specialist, but comfortable with web-forward creative execution and able to show strong web work in your portfolio.

• Actively uses AI tools as part of your creative practice, spanning ideation, production, and workflow. You bring genuine curiosity and a point of view on how AI can make your work better and faster.

• Strong foundational design skills: typography, color, composition, and visual storytelling.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and similar design tools.

• Comfortable working from briefs and creative direction, with an ability to interpret ambiguity and ask the right clarifying questions.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without dropping the ball.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

• Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.

• Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.

• Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.

• User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.

• LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution.

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).

Responsibilities

• Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high.

• Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.

• Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.

• Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings.

• Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.

• Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments.

• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.

• Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.

• Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing.

• Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them.

• Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers.

• Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.

• Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)

• Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects.

• Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

Benefits:

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Private Pension plan with Employer-matching

• 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan

• Income Replacement Programs

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors .

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.
