title: Data Analyst
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to work as close as possible to the teams that run RevenueCat's business, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, People, Ops, Product, etc.

The most valuable thing on our Analytics team today isn't SQL, it's domain knowledge. Knowing what a trial start actually counts, why tracked revenue and realized revenue are different, how store refunds land in our data, and which model answers a question correctly the first time. That knowledge is what turns a half-formed Slack question into a number someone can act on within the hour.

So you'll spend most of your time with business teams: understanding what they're trying to decide, turning vague questions into analysis, and shipping the datasets and dashboards they rely on. You'll build that domain knowledge fast, working day to day with the person who currently owns Analytics here. He'll be your closest partner and the person who helps you grow into the domain.

The second thing that makes this role exciting is how we expect you to work. We're building the infrastructure that lets AI agents access our data safely, and agentic tooling that answers questions grounded in our semantic layer rather than guessing. You'll be one of its heaviest users and one of the people who makes it trustworthy: curating the semantic context, catching the answers that look right and aren't, and pushing definitions back into dbt and LookML where they belong. We're not hiring someone to do the same volume of work faster, we're hiring someone who supports multiple teams well using this collection of new tools as a force multiplier.

What you will do

•

Partner regularly with Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product teams. Learn their goals, their metrics, and the decisions they're actually stuck on.

•

Own analysis end to end: clarify the real question, build or pick the right dataset, deliver the answer, and make sure a decision follows.

•

Go deep on our subscription domain, then write it down. Metric definitions, caveats, always-filters, known gotchas. Domain knowledge that only lives in your head doesn't scale, and scaling it is the point of this role.

•

Build analytics assets people trust without asking you first: models in dbt, explores in LookML, dashboards that hold up.

•

Use our agent tooling as a force multiplier and contribute back to it. Feed it semantic context, flag wrong answers, harden the definitions it depends on.

•

Contribute to the data platform where it unblocks you. Small model and pipeline improvements, debugging discrepancies, helping out when something breaks.

•

Translate in both directions: business context into robust analysis, data reality into language a non-technical stakeholder can act on.

About you

3+ years in an analytics role (Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer or similar), including real experience as the direct analytics partner to a business team such as Marketing, Sales or Finance.

Curiosity is the thing we're actually screening for:

•

You're uncomfortable when you don't understand why a number is what it is, and you dig until you do.

•

You ask the question behind the question. When someone asks for a dashboard, you find out what decision it's for.

•

You'd rather learn a new domain than a new tool.

•

You're comfortable without fully formed requirements, and you create structure where none exists yet.

•

You care more about being useful and clear than about polished dashboards.

•

You want to be a partner to the business, not a request queue.

From a skills perspective, you bring:

•

Strong SQL and real comfort working directly in a warehouse. You can get to an answer without hand-holding.

•

Experience owning datasets and dashboards that non-technical teams depend on.

•

Comfortable working in a repo: git, branches, pull requests, code review. Our analytics lives in version-controlled dbt and LookML repos, not in saved queries.

•

You already work with AI agents daily and you're appropriately skeptical of them. You can explain how you verified an answer, not just how you produced one.

•

Clear written communication, especially about limits, caveats, and what a number does not say.

Nice to have, and genuinely not required:

•

Python, dbt, Looker or LookML, Snowflake or ClickHouse

•

Subscription or fintech domain experience

•

High-volume data

What we offer:

•

Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

•

10-year window to exercise vested equity options

•

A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

•

4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

•

Paid desk at a co-working space

•

Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

•

How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

•

The values that guide how we work: Our Values

•

How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

•

What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

•

What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

title: Marketing Lead (m/f/x)
description:
10 Mio. ARR, Upmarket-Expansion und AI-first Company Building.

Die Rolle und worum es geht

Du entwickelst unser Marketing weiter und ownst dabei ein breites Spektrum - Content, Brand, Social, Kampagnen, Website-Inhalte und Events. Du baust die Taktung, etablierst unser Brandkonzept weiter, konzipierst Kampagnen und verantwortest Social Media. Events wie unser PlanD Werk und Messen ziehst du mit und bewertest daten-getrieben, wie effektiv welche Maßnahmen sind.

Wir sind ein schlankes Team; du hast echte Ownership und berichtest direkt ans Leadership. Vieles machst du am Anfang selbst, ein Team kann später dazukommen.

AI ist für uns dabei zentral. Content wird bei uns agentisch supported und erstellt. Du solltest Lust haben, dich hier voll reinzuhängen.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Social-Taktung aufbauen und halten (LinkedIn, Instagram)

• Brandkonzept weiterentwickeln und im Alltag durchziehen

• Kampagnen konzipieren, von Print bis Digital

• Inhalte selbst erstellen, mit Agents im Workflow, und in Umlauf bringen: Website, Landingpages, Newsletter, Kundenstimmen

• Messen, was Inhalte und Kampagnen bringen, und darauf aufbauen

• PlanD Werk und Messen mitorganisieren und gemeinsam mit Sales als Lead-Quelle nutzen

• Die Marketing-Funktion from the ground up mit aufbauen

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

• Sichtbare Marke und starkes Wachstum in einer riesigen, noch wenig digitalisierten Branche

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Leadership und einem effizienten, kleinen Team im schönen Office in Berlin Mitte

• Hands-on: Gute Ideen werden direkt umgesetzt

• AI-Spielwiese: Wir bauen Content- und Company-Prozesse AI-first um; du gestaltest mit, wie Marketing-Teams von morgen arbeiten

Was du mitbringen solltest

Must-haves

• Taste für besondere Marken und Content, und Lust, Inhalte selbst zu machen

• Growth-Mindset: Du misst, was deine Inhalte bringen, von Reichweite bis Anfrage, und baust darauf auf

• AI-first: Starke Tool-Nutzung, Experimentierung, agentischer Content-Alltag

• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (wichtig für unsere Kunden)

Nice-to-haves

• 1–3 Jahre Marketing, Agency oder Startup

• Erfahrung mit Marketing-Analytics

• Branchenbezug zu Gebäudereinigung, Handwerk oder Field Services

Diese Rolle ist ideal, wenn du

• Inhalte selbst machen und sehen willst, was sie bewegen

• Taste und Tempo mitbringst und Marketing vom Boden auf mitbauen willst

• AI-first denkst und arbeitest

title: Virtual Access Specialist
description:
The Virtual Access Specialist acts as a non-clinical virtual resource that is available to educate and address Health Care Provider (HCP) questions about patient access. This is a remote role that calls directly on HCP offices in the assigned, specific geography to address questions about patient access & reimbursement. Provides expertise on coverage and reimbursement barriers to better enhance the patient experience and effectively navigate the complexities of the local healthcare landscape and overcome access barriers. Responsibilities include educating HCPs about access and reimbursement via AbbVie approved support tools, advising HCPs on patient prescription status, program eligibility, and educating offices on payer processes and procedures.

Specific Responsibilities:

• Educate HCPs on patient support programs, including approved access and reimbursement through AbbVie support tools and services.

• Be a subject matter expert on relevant local, regional, and national payer policies to appropriately educate providers on payer requirements.

• Develop and sustain relationships with relevant providers within the territory. Utilize strong communication skills to facilitate clear, concise, and efficient information exchanges with Field Reimbursement Managers (FRMs), HCPs, and other stakeholders.

• Effectively work in a high cross-matrix environment, implementing appropriate ways of working communication with teams in sales, market access, patient service peers, to update HCPs on Rx status and program eligibility.

• Demonstrate agility to effectively incorporate the use of approved resources and data to appropriately support HCP education initiatives that enhance the patient’s experience.

• Identify and report back payer trends related for approved products to Patient Services and market access account management teams.

• Take ownership of process improvement initiatives, continuously seeking ways to enhance system efficiency and patient access strategies.

• Bachelor’s degree or Associate degree in fields such as biological sciences, pharmacy, business related field, or equivalent preferred.

• 3-5 years of experience in account management, payer account management, and/or access and reimbursement.

• Thorough understanding of payer policy processes, published criteria and documentation for coverage, coding, prior authorization, and appeal processes.

• Demonstrated understanding of the rules, regulations and risks associated with provision of reimbursement support services.

• Comprehensive understanding of commercial and governmental payer access dynamics

• Strong communicator with proven ability to navigate cross-matrix environments, ensuring clear, concise, and timely information exchange between internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment.

• Utilize critical thinking to assess and prioritize workloads at the account level, ensuring optimal resource allocation and seamless operations

A fast-paced environment backed by the world's best investors with the world's leading organizations as customers

title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role & How we work
As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.
You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build. What you will do
Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.
Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.
Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.
Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.
Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.
Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.
The experience you bring
3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.
Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.
Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.
Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.
Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.
Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.
Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.
2 reasons why you should not apply
You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.
You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.
Your mindset
You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.
You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.
You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.
You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.
You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.
What we offer
Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.
Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.
A motivated, highly international team (15 nationalities) that gathers in person at our Berlin HQ and supports each other, with flat hierarchies and direct interaction with our management team and investors.
Visa sponsorship, relocation support, and a competitive compensation package with a meaningful variable component tied to fund performance.

title: Content Designer | LATAM
description:
Location : Remote – Central or South America (Open to applicants anywhere in Central or South America)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Senior Content Designer at Fueled, you’ll bring clarity to complex product experiences through thoughtful, strategic content design. You’ll partner closely with design, product, and engineering teams to shape content systems that scale by moving beyond copy to define structure, meaning, and user understanding across digital products.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

• Lead content design across client engagements, shaping clear, user-centered experiences through content strategy, UX writing, and information architecture.

• Translate ambiguous product and business goals into structured content models, messaging frameworks, and scalable content systems.

• Write and adapt content to meet client needs, balancing brand voice, user experience, and business objectives.

• Collaborate with product designers, engineers, and stakeholders to integrate content seamlessly into the product development process.

• Define and deliver key content artifacts (e.g., audits, taxonomies, content models, voice and tone guidelines) while facilitating workshops to align teams on strategy and direction.

What you will achieve:

• Deliver content systems and experiences that improve clarity, usability, and overall product effectiveness.

• Create scalable content foundations that support long-term product growth and consistency across platforms.

• Help teams move from ambiguity to clarity by structuring content in ways that enable confident design and engineering decisions.

• Strengthen collaboration across disciplines by integrating content design into product thinking from the start.

• Raise the bar for content design craft across projects, contributing to thoughtful, strategic, and user-centered outcomes.

About you:

• You have 4+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally within an agency environment.

• You thrive in fast-paced, multi-client settings and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.

• You bring a strategic approach to content, with experience in content modeling, IA, and structured content.

• You have experience working with CMS platforms and shaping how content is structured and managed.

• You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to align teams and clearly articulate content decisions to clients and stakeholders.

Contractor Fee

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs.

Join our Contractor Pool

This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles.

If you are passionate about Fueled’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We’d appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you’ll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here .

We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@fueled.com to your contacts list!

title: Content Manager
description:
About the Role

Playson is a leading online gaming supplier with worldwide recognition which was founded in 2012. We offer complete gaming solutions based on the latest technologies and detailed market analysis for the leading iGaming operators. We are looking for a Senior Content Manager. You’ll be part of a passionate, collaborative team that plays a key role in ensuring successful releases. No micromanagement, no endless bureaucracy, just meaningful creative work, ownership, and reach.

Key Responsibilities

•

Write compelling and accurate texts for game previews and game rules in English.

•

Implement the rules for the game clients.

•

Work with structured file types (XML/JSON) to implement visual and textual content elements in a product.

•

Oversee translation of the game rules and documentation through platforms like Crowdin, ensuring consistency and adherence to layout and character limitations.

•

Collaborate with a cross-functional development team to polish and verify in-game content.

•

Plan and manage content delivery according to game development milestones and market launch schedules.

•

Create documentation that is compliant with market requirements and international legal regulations.

•

Create names for games, game families, and built-in features, and review their accessibility by researching market trends and trademark databases.

Requirements

•

iGaming experience, with a strong grasp of game mechanics and player engagement loops in slots or casino-style products.

•

Organisational strength - tracking feedback, syncing with multiple stakeholders, and keeping documents and content tidy.

•

Logical and structured thinking with the skill to organise information in a concise and easy-to-understand way.

•

Ability to simplify complex mechanics into engaging, digestible explanations for a non-technical audience.

•

Strong written English - grammar perfect, typo-averse, and able to write both crisply and cleverly.

•

Experience producing user-friendly content for product and marketing use (UI description, previews, help info, or launch comms).

•

A mind for naming - capable of creating titles, features, and hooks that feel fresh, bold, and aligned with the product.

•

Comfort working with text files and structured formats (XML/JSON).

•

Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), with the ability to critically evaluate their output and apply it appropriately.

•

Proactive, reliable, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and the flexibility to respond to changing priorities, resolve issues quickly, and continuously look for ways to improve processes and efficiency.

•

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams, maintain clear communication throughout the game development process, and reliably deliver work on time.

Nice to Have

•

Prior exposure to slot mechanics, mobile games, or casino-style content.

•

Basic proficiency with Photoshop - navigating layers, updating fonts, and exporting polished visuals

•

Familiarity with Crowdin or similar translation/localisation management platforms.

•

Experience working in IDEs (e.g., VSCode, WebStorm, Cursor) for light content verification or JSON editing.

What We Offer

Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive salary, subject to annual performance reviews

•

Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system

•

Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs

•

Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort

•

Medical Insurance: Receive comprehensive medical insurance for both you and a significant other

•

Financial Support for Life Events: We provide financial support during special life events

•

Unlimited Paid Vacation: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave, including Ukrainian bank holidays

•

Unlimited Paid Sick Leave: Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary

•

Professional Development: Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training

Recruitment Process

•

HR Interview

•

Take Home Task

•

Technical Interview

Final Interview

title: Case Resolution Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them.

You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility.

As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

• Synthesize and share customer insights. Surface patterns from your cases in weekly and monthly reports, participate in Product and Engineering discussions with what you're learning, and mentor Support Team members on AI workflows, scripting, and SQL queries.

title: Expert Comics - Tintin & Dutch Traditional Comics
description:
At Catawiki , every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.
We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.
Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.
Taking ownership and driving impact
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers.
Your Mission
As an Expert for Tintin, Dutch and Traditional Comics, you will manage and curate high-quality auctions for the Netherlands and Belgium region. Your mission is to use your market knowledge and network to create compelling auctions that attract bidders and ensure a fair and transparent experience for sellers and buyers.
By combining commercial insight with subject matter expertise, you will strengthen the quality, relevance, and performance of your auctions.
What You’ll Do
Evaluate and arrange comic book lots submitted by users, ensuring quality and relevance
Create attractive and engaging lot listings on a weekly basis
Review lot titles, descriptions, and images, and provide accurate value estimates
Maintain fairness and transparency by accepting or rejecting submissions in a professional manner
Curate auctions that attract bidders and drive strong performance
Collaborate with the Sales team to attract new sellers and diversify the auction selection
Partner with the Marketing team to increase bidder attention and engagement
What You’ll Bring
Passion and expertise in Comics, with strong knowledge of the industry
Excellent commercial skills, including proven negotiation and relationship-building experience
Strong network within the Comics industry
Ability to work autonomously and make quick decisions in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
Good computer skills
Good command of Dutch and English, preferably French
Where You’ll Be
This is a remote role that can be based from The Netherlands or Belgium.
Why You'll Love Working with Us
Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.
Our Offices and Way of Working
Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.
Interested?
Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
description:
Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required)
Classification : Full-time, exempt
Reports to : School Leader
Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour
Welcome to Miaplaza!
Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!
MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð
Role Summary
The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Instructional Staff Management
Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.
Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.
Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.
Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.
Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.
Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.
Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.
Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity
Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.
Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.
Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.
Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.
Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.
Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.
Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â
Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.
Academic Data & Testing Coordination
Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.
Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.
Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.
Professional Development
Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.
Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.
Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.
Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration
Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.
Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.
Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.
Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.
Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â
What We're Looking For
Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers
Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate
A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals
Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny
A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability
Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions
Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities
Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment
Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback
THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred
Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements
At least 3 years of teaching experience
At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal
Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online
Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews
Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems
The Ideal Candidate Brings:
Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data
Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school
Compensation & Benefits
The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.
Miaplazaâs compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.
Compensation is evaluated twice per year, based on performance.
Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.
All employees are eligible for a retirement plan with employer match.
PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 200hours per year or 25 eight-hour days on average.
Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves an assessment, followed by two or more interviews and a role-specific assignment.
We're building an inclusive workplace where everyone belongs. As an equal-opportunity employer and E-Verify participant, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. title: General Manager, Collibra Public Sector
description:
Headquarters: Remote, East Coast USA

Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent. Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

• Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm

• Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts

• Manage overall expense to revenue targets

• Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities

• Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams

• Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

• Demonstrated ability to manage directly and delegate effectively across all areas of responsibilities

• Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector

• Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy

• Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data

• Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

• Experience managing a complete public sector subsidiary within a larger organization

• Extend

title: QA Analyst (Mexico, Remote)
description:
At Varicent , we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the 2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM , 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index , Gartner Peer Insights , 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and G2. Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

• Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.

• Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.

• Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.

• Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

As a QA Analyst, you will be supporting the quality, reliability and performance of Varicent's Incentives application, designed to automate, model and manage complex sales compensation plans. The role is responsible for identifying issues, contributing to process improvements, and helping ensure a seamless user experience. Working under the guidance of senior staff, you will be testing low to moderate complexity issues, developing testing requirements from that direction. Work performed in this role directly supports the trust users place in the platform.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Performs manual testing to validate new features and bug fixes.

• Validates API responses and tests database interactions to ensure system reliability.

• Identifies and reports defects, providing clear and detailed information, for small-size projects, working under the guidance of senior staff.

• Identifies, documents, and prioritizes bugs in JIRA or similar tools.

• Re-tests fixed defects and performs regression testing before releases.

• Works on simple defects unaided and contributes to testing medium-size projects with guidance.

• Identifies "happy path" and negative tests based on given requirements.

• Identifies the scope of small features or fixes based on overall business goals.

• Identifies the priority of test cases and provides estimates for assignments.

• Works with QA and development peers to analyze technical problems and escalates problems to leads.

• Contributes to refining the QA process by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting improvements.

• Stays current on QA trends and tools to improve testing practices.

• Takes action to improve processes and makes sound, timely decisions using the information and resources available.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• • 0–2 years of experience.

• • Basic knowledge of software testing methodologies, including manual testing.

• • Familiarity with QA tools such as JIRA or Postman.

• • Basic understanding of REST APIs and database testing.

• • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• • Good understanding of product functionality and architecture and how it fits into the business.

• • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

• • B2 level English or higher is required.

FIRST 30 DAYS: GETTING STARTED

• Familiarize yourself with the product, team structure, and development workflow.

• Understand the testing framework and review existing test cases and reports.

• Start testing minor features and logging bugs to learn the system.

• Participate in team meetings and shadow senior QA analysts during test planning sessions.

FIRST 60 DAYS: BUILDING MOMENTUM

• Take ownership of writing and executing test cases for client bugs, small features or modules.

• Collaborate with the development team to test more complex features and identify potential edge cases.

FIRST 90 DAYS: HITTING YOUR STRIDE

• Gained increased knowledge of the System under test

• Increased ownership of testing tasks or projects

• Provide feedback to the team on onboarding processes and identify areas for improvement in QA workflows.

For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is between $450,900.00 - 591,700.00 MXN. In addition to base salary, our compensation package may include bonuses, commissions for eligible sales roles, and a comprehensive benefits package. The actual base salary will vary based on factors including individual qualifications and market data, as objectively assessed during the interview process.

This posting is for a existing vacancy.

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

Overview of Benefits:

• Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs

• Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most

• Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you

• Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning

• Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value

• Retirement — Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security

• Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development

• Flexibility — Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions

Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. • Leave Claim Specialist: $25.00 - $26.00 plus annual bonus opportunity.

• Sr Leave Claim Specialist $27.00 – $29.00 plus annual bonus opportunity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Makes sound recommendations and works towards independent decision-making by thoroughly evaluating claims and gathering necessary information to formulate action plans.

• Develops files that demonstrate appropriate decision-making based on claim facts, policy provisions, state regulations, and customer expectations, ensuring all actions and rationales are well-documented.

• Establishes and maintains professional relationships with claimants, brokers, sales organizations, vendor partners, employers, and internal partners, ensuring communication aligns with Mutual of Omaha's values.

• Accurately determines financial liability based on various factors and manages claims with limited autonomy to approve payments, ensuring timely and accurate claims processing.

• Communicates professionally with high customer service standards, both written and verbal, and effectively diffuses situations and escalates when necessary.

• Proficient in personal computers, Microsoft applications, and Mutual of Omaha systems, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, adaptability to change, and the ability to manage ongoing claims for multi-year durations.

Job Description:

The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement is a senior business-facing technology leader responsible for helping Consulting and Managed Services use technology effectively to improve growth, scalability, efficiency, client delivery, and business performance. This role develops a deep understanding of the businesses supported and translates business needs into clear technology recommendations and roadmaps, with a core focus on using existing enterprise capabilities, third-party platforms, and commercial software effectively and ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful value.\

Essential Job Functions, Responsibilities & Duties:

1. Serve as a strategic technology advisor

• Build trusted relationships with business and practice leaders and understand their strategies, operating models, workflows, economics, and technology needs.

• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, scalability, quality, client experience, or risk management.

• Distinguish problems requiring technology investment from those better addressed through process, adoption, operating-model, or organizational changes.

• Turn complex business and technology considerations into clear options, recommendations, and actions; challenge assumptions and recommend a path forward.

• Partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, Security, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Risk, and business leadership to establish ownership and decision rights and drive work to outcomes.

40%

2. Lead and develop the Technology Enablement team

• Lead and develop a team of 3-5 direct reports, setting clear expectations for business understanding, analytical rigor, judgment, communication, and accountability.

• Build independent, high-performing team members who bring recommendations and ownership rather than simply coordinating activity or reporting information.

• Create clear accountability, delegate effectively, coach decision-making, and address performance or ownership gaps promptly.

30%

3. Lead third-party technology and application portfolio strategy

• Own visibility into and stewardship of material third-party applications used across the supported service lines.

• Evaluate whether business needs should be addressed through existing enterprise capabilities, improved adoption or configuration, commercial software, or an internally developed solution.

• Evaluate software vendors and platforms based on business fit, capabilities, cost, risk, architecture, and strategic alignment.

• Drive recommendations regarding investment, expansion, consolidation, rationalization, replacement, and retirement, while improving value realization and reducing unnecessary cost and complexity.

15%

4. Shape technology roadmaps and investment priorities

• Develop service-line technology roadmaps aligned to business strategy and enterprise technology direction.

• Help leaders prioritize investments based on value, strategic alignment, cost, risk, complexity, readiness, and capacity.

• Connect initiatives across the portfolio to reduce duplication and fragmented technology decisions.

• Surface risks, dependencies, ownership gaps, and decisions early and drive them toward resolution.

15%

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree required; degree in technology, business, accounting, or a related field preferred. MBA preferred.

• 8 years of progressive experience in business technology, technology strategy, technology consulting, application portfolio management, enterprise/business applications, digital transformation, product management, or a related field required

• Experience translating business strategies and complex business problems into technology recommendations and actionable roadmaps; evaluating commercial software and vendors; and managing or advising on an application or technology portfolio, including investment and lifecycle decisions. Experience in professional services, financial services, healthcare, or similarly complex industries preferred.
• Strong business and financial judgment with the ability to evaluate value, cost, risk, tradeoffs, and strategic alignment; understanding of complex, technology-dependent business environments.

• Strong executive communication and stakeholder leadership; demonstrated ability to translate business strategies into technology recommendations and actionable roadmaps; meaningful experience evaluating commercial software, technology vendors, and alternative solution approaches.

• Enough technical depth to engage credibly with architecture and engineering teams without needing to be the engineering owner; ability to influence across organizational boundaries, lead and develop high-performing team members, make recommendations, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.

Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

The national pay rate range is $131,500 to $206,100

title: Senior Data Scientist, Audio
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the intersection between research and data: people who think deeply about what conversational data is actually composed of, what makes data valuable, and how to best leverage that.

Conversational audio presents incredibly rich scientific, engineering, and infrastructure challenges that are orders of magnitude harder than working with text. Speech carries speakers, accents, dialects, emotion, overlapping talk, code-switching, domain vocabulary, and acoustic conditions that range from a quiet studio to a drive-through — all with rich context that moves the conversation. In this role you'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and data teams to answer those questions rigorously and at scale. You'll care deeply about what makes conversational data difficult, you'll characterize it, and you'll shape the strategies that turn it into model gains. This role rewards conviction, creativity in approach, and a real appetite for overturning your own assumptions when the data says otherwise.

This is a hands-on, high-leverage role with unusual latitude to define an area from first principles. It reports to the VP of Data Operations. We're looking for people who:

•

See "we've always done it this way" as a starting position to argue with, not a constraint to work around

•

Can find the one experiment that settles a question in days rather than months

•

Are creative about where signal hides — in metadata, in model confidence, in the failures

•

Have the vision to take a scrappy proof-of-concept and scale it 100x

•

Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify their own impact

What You'll Own

•

Understand and characterize our data. Build the analysis that tells us what we actually have — languages, conditions, domains, speakers, quality — and what's underrepresented.

•

•

Change our minds about what data strategies actually work. Run the experiments that separate what works from what everyone assumes works.

•

Care about data consistency, cleanliness, and organization — and about making data legible and accessible to non-technical teams, not just to the people who built the pipelines.

•

Bring method and automation to model adaptation. Turn one-off, domain- and customer-specific model work into repeatable, documented pipelines.

What We're Looking For

•

Hands-on work on real data pipelines and model-facing problems in data science, ML, or applied research

•

Strong Python and data tooling; comfort building analysis, scoring, and automation yourself

•

Experience with data characterization, data selection, active learning, or similar "what should we work on next" problems

•

Working familiarity with speech/audio or NLP models — you can reason about model output quality, confidence, and error modes

•

A track record of turning ambiguous, messy data situations into measurable model or product improvements

•

You build systems others run without you in the room — a reusable harness, not a one-off notebook

•

Strong communication skills, especially translating complex findings for audiences who don't share your background

•

An active AI-tool user. Not aspirational — tell us what you use and what you've built with it

It would be great if you also had:

•

Direct experience with ASR/TTS, audio data, or multilingual/code-switched data.

•

Experience with ensemble labeling, pseudo-labeling, or LLM-assisted annotation.

•

Familiarity with data provenance, PII/GDPR-aware pipelines, or model-improvement compliance.

•

Experience building custom or fine-tuned models for specific customers or domains.

•

Comfort working directly with research and engineering teams on shared infrastructure.

title: Founder's Associate (m/w/d) – Vollzeit-Praktikum ab November 2026
description:
therapie1 ist heute eine Physiotherapie-Praxis in München-Pasing, und der Anfang von etwas Größerem. Der Physio-Markt in Deutschland ist stark zersplittert, fast überall gibt es nur kleine Einzelpraxen. Wir wollen diesen Markt disrupten und eine Physio-Kette mit mehreren Standorten aufbauen. Der nächste Standort ist in Planung, und du steigst genau jetzt ein. Backed by Super Angels und Thirty Eight Capital.

Du arbeitest direkt neben Tobi

Tobi hat therapie1 im April 2026 gegründet. Davor hat er bei home24 als SVP und Mitglied des Executive Teams einen Marktplatz aufgebaut, der in zwei Jahren über 150 Mio. € Umsatz erreicht hat. Bei Amazon hat er das New Vendor Management für 17 Kategorien geleitet, bei der Boston Consulting Group war er Project Leader. Du arbeitest jeden Tag mit ihm zusammen, bist bei Entscheidungen dabei und lernst, wie man ein Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbaut.

Eckdaten

•

Start: 1. November 2026 (oder kurz danach)

•

Dauer: ab 3 Monaten, Vollzeit, vor Ort in München-Pasing

•

Übernahme in eine Festanstellung möglich

•

Bezahltes Praktikum, die Vergütung richtet sich nach Praktikumsart und Erfahrung

•

Deutsch fließend (mindestens C1)

Woran du in den nächsten Monaten arbeitest

•

Neuer Standort: Lagen und Flächen suchen und die Due Diligence machen: Einzugsgebiet, Wettbewerb, Ärzt:innen in der Umgebung, Mietvertrag, Business Case. Am Ende steht eine Entscheidungsvorlage für Tobi.

•

Recruiting-Pipeline: Therapeut:innen, Rezeption und Trainer:innen für unser Team finden. Du schreibst die Anzeigen, sprichst Leute direkt an, pflegst die Pipeline im CRM, führst die ersten Gespräche und begleitest den Prozess bis zur Zusage.

•

Growth: neue Patient:innen gewinnen, Kampagnen testen, Ergebnisse auswerten

•

Social Media und Kommunikation: Instagram und LinkedIn aufbauen, Inhalte planen und umsetzen, Kommunikation im Team verbessern

•

Prozesse: Abläufe in Praxis und Verwaltung einführen und dokumentieren, damit sie auch mit dem zweiten Standort funktionieren. Gern mit KI-Tools.

•

Projektmanagement: mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig steuern, Deadlines halten, Tobi den Rücken freihalten

•

Investor:innen: Du bereitest das wöchentliche Meeting mit unseren Super Angels vor (Zahlen, Fortschritt, offene Fragen), bist dabei und setzt die Ergebnisse um.

•

und alles, was in der Woche gerade am wichtigsten ist

Was du mitbringst

•

Du studierst oder hast gerade abgeschlossen, die Fachrichtung ist egal

•

Deutsch fließend, gutes Englisch

•

Erste Erfahrung in einem Startup, in der Beratung, im Marketing oder mit einem eigenen Projekt

•

Du schaffst selbst Struktur und ziehst Dinge durch

•

Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu und kannst andere für eine Idee begeistern

•

Gespür für Social Media und gute Kommunikation, Spaß an Zahlen und KI-Tools

Was du bekommst

•

Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit einem Gründer mit Erfahrung bei BCG, Amazon und home24

•

Jede Woche direkter Austausch mit unseren Super Angels

•

Echte Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an

•

Gleichzeitig Einblick in Expansion, Recruiting, Growth und Operations

•

Die Möglichkeit, fest einzusteigen und den neuen Standort dann mit aufzubauen

•

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen

•

Eine Referenz, die etwas zählt

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und 2–3 Sätze dazu: Was hast du aufgebaut, organisiert oder verbessert, worauf du stolz bist? Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

title: Venture Developer Photovoltaik (m/w/d)
description:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Venture Developer Photovoltaik (m/w/d) baust du bei GALVANY ein komplett neues Geschäftsfeld von null auf – direkt im CEO-Office und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Gründer Raik und dem Leadership-Team.

Deine Aufgaben

•

End-to-End Operating Model: Du baust die gesamte operative Lieferkette für unser PV-Geschäft auf – vom Vertriebsabschluss über Beschaffung und Lagerung der Module bis zur finalen Installation beim Kunden – und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf zwischen allen Schritten.

•

Lieferanten- & Installateursnetzwerk: Du identifizierst, verhandelst mit und baust belastbare Partnerschaften mit PV-Modul-Herstellern, Großhändlern und Installationsbetrieben auf – und steuerst diese im laufenden Betrieb.

•

Prozessaufbau & -optimierung: Du baust die operativen Prozesse entlang der gesamten Journey (Vertrieb → Planung → Beschaffung → Installation → Abnahme) von Grund auf, dokumentierst sie sauber und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter.

•

Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations, Product und Customer Success zusammen, um das PV-Geschäft nahtlos in unsere bestehende Customer Journey zu integrieren und Reibungsverluste an den Schnittstellen zu minimieren.

•

Research & strategische Analyse: Du führst eigenständig Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen für den PV-Markt durch, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab und bereitest Ergebnisse für das Leadership-Team auf.

•

AI & Automation: Du identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale entlang der operativen Prozesskette (z. B. Kapazitätsplanung, Installateurs-Scheduling), testest KI-Tools und -Workflows und trägst aktiv dazu bei, wie GALVANY künstliche Intelligenz operativ einsetzt.

Dein Profil

•

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Master Studium an einer Top-Universität in einem wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Studiengang.

•

Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen in einem dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt z. B. in einem Start-up, einer Unternehmensberatung oder einem VC.

•

Du denkst strukturiert, analytisch und zahlenaffin und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte schnell durchdringen, sauber aufbereiten und klar kommunizieren.

•

Du trittst sicher auf und überzeugst unterschiedliche Stakeholder, intern wie extern, durch präzise, verständliche Kommunikation, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen.

•

Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst Themen eigenverantwortlich voran und verlierst auch in einem schnellen, sich verändernden Umfeld nicht den Überblick.

•

Du bist neugierig auf KI-Tools und Automatisierung und hast idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen damit gesammelt oder den Willen, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

•

Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

•

Entrepreneurial Mindset – Du übernimmst Verantwortung, handelst proaktiv und machst aus Unklarheit eine Chance.

•

Methodical – Du denkst und arbeitest geordnet, klar und nachvollziehbar – in deinen Gedankengängen genauso wie in deiner Dokumentation.

•

Strategic Thinker – Du planst über den nächsten Monat hinaus und bringst die richtigen Initiativen zur richtigen Zeit auf den Weg.

•

Clear Communicator – Du bereitest komplexe Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich auf und bleibst auch in schwierigen Situationen sachlich und klar.

•

Collaborative – Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, um Strategie und Umsetzung aufeinander abzustimmen.

Benefits

•

Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

•

Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

•

Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

•

Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

•

Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

title: Sr. Analyst, Revenue Operations and Analytics
description:
About Zuora
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.
The Opportunity
Drive transparency, predictability, and insights to the organization through actionable GTM reporting and business intelligence at scale across all levels of the organization.
What You'll Achieve:
Support our GTM strategy through a portfolio of dashboards and reports that surface actionable insights
Build out a standardized and effective forecasting framework and review process with cross-functional teams
Maintain reusable definitions in markdown-based documentation and other shared knowledge assets to support team enablement and skill-building
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to answer critical business questions and deliver data-driven insights
Proactively identify opportunities to further fuel our GTM organization's growth
About You
Required Experience & Skills:
4+ years' experience in sales strategy, sales operations, business analyst, or financial analyst role
Proficiency with Claude Code (Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool), or comparable AI-assisted development/automation tools, to build and maintain reporting scripts, automate data pipelines, and accelerate ad hoc analysis
Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a solid ability to drive towards action and impact
Experience with data modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data science techniques
Motivation to work cross-functionally with various stakeholders, including Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Finance
Ability to work in a dynamic setting while maintaining accuracy and delivering against deadlines
Demonstrated ability to manage analytic projects from inception to delivery, including developing structured scalable solutions
Understanding of how sales models/sales processes work as well as sales forecasting business processes
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
Preferred Qualifications:
Champion AI-first approaches to analytics, reporting, and business intelligence
Experience in SaaS, subscription, consumption, or recurring revenue business models
Experience with forecasting, predictive analytics, and statistical modeling
Experience supporting CFO, CRO, or executive leadership teams
About the Team
Field Operations is the heartbeat of Zuora's tier-one team. With an innovative operational infrastructure and enablement cadence, we empower our front-line sales team to systematically sell better, faster, and more efficiently as they partner internally and externally with our customers, prospects, and ecosystem partners. So, it's no surprise we strive for operational excellence in all that we do.
Alignment with the data and analytics teams across the organization will be essential for success in this role.
Benefits
Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
Mental wellbeing resources and support
*Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process
#ZEOLife at Zuora
ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
Learn constantly and iterate often
Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent, where applicable).
The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here .
Base Pay Details
$99,500—$132,000 USD
