description:
Manager, Clinical Data Management leads clinical data management team to handle project management documentation, preform clinical data management activities and system implementations for EDETEKâs CONFORM eClinical, write design specifications for the system (forms, reports, etc.), and facilitate testing of system implementations. In addition to stay hands-on with clinical data management operations and activities, Manager of Clinical Data Management oversees data management projects to ensure quality, timely delivery and ongoing client satisfaction; identifies client needs and develops creative solutions for projects, leveraging expertise, operational capabilities and technologies; communicates with clients and internal teams.

The Manager, Clinical Data Management should thoroughly understand the requirements for Good Clinical Data Management services, including its documentation; be involved in start-up or wrap-up of in-house and client-specific data management projects; have an understanding of the relevant therapeutic indications, study hypotheses, and trial design; and have a solid understanding of database design and structure.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Support internal clinical data management initiatives
• Complete traditional and assigned data management operations/activities
• Contribute to project success by communicating with clients about requirements and issues, leveraging expertise, enforcing standard operation procedures, monitoring project progress and timelines.
• Assist in the development and maintenance of systems used to support project infrastructure
• Work with Clinical Data Specialists (CDSs) to execute Data Management Plans
• Lead the communication with clients/sponsors as necessary to deliver contracted clinical data management services and clinical data with high quality and integrity
• Ensure filing of all required documentation per EDETEK and project requirements
• Lead Use Acceptance Testing (UAT) on new software
• Select and interview clinical data manager candidates
• Train and guide junior team members

• Ability to communicate effectively in the English language in person, by phone and in writing.
• Ability to lead functional meetings
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy is a must
• Excellent organizational skills
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects
• Ability to work collaboratively, effectively, and productively in diverse organization structures.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and complete tasks to deadlines: Delivering Excellence, Serving Customers, Accountability and Ownership, Global and Cross-Functional Communication
• Ability to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
• Ability to work positively within a continually changing environment.
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
• Advanced computer skills and practical knowledge of MS Office and potentially project management software.
• A Bachelorâs degree or equivalent combination of Education/Training/Experience is required. A degree in a scientific, medical, or technological discipline is preferred.
• A minimum of 2 years of clinical trial or clinical data management experience or similar industry experience/training is required.
• Prior trial responsibility for the entire data management life-cycle is desirable.
• Working knowledge of EDC studies and SAS is required.
• Corporate office environment.
• Some travel (5%) may be required with a potential of travel occurring over weekends.
• Cross-functional interactions

Benefits vary by country, but remain competitive. Below is a sample of the benefits offered to U.S. employees.

• Choice of comprehensive Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance plans
• Paid vacation time and sick days
• Corporate holidays annually
• Participation in the 401K Plan
• Comprehensive perks and discount programs for AAA, wholesale, insurance, Rx, fitness, pets, entertainment, etc.
• Health Advocate and Employee Assistance Program
Location

This is a remote position, and we are open to candidates based in the United States.

EDETEK is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on the basis of an individualâs race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. title: Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer - iOS/Android, KMP & DevOps
description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

• Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.

• Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.

• Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.

• Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.

• Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.

• Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.

• Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.

• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.

• Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.

• Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

• Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.

• Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.

• Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.

• Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.

• Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.

• Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.

• The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.

• Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.

• Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.

• Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.

• Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.

• Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.

• Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.

• The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.

• Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.

• The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.

• Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

• Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.

• GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.

• Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.

• Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.

• Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.

• Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

• A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.

• Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.

• A central role supporting our mobile development team.

• The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.

• Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.

• Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

• Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.

• Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.

• Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.

• The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.

• Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.

• Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

title: Senior Manager, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing
description:
We are changing FINANCE to finance CHANGE!

At Climate First Bank , we’re redefining what banking can be. As a Florida Benefit Corporation and FDIC-insured commercial bank, we offer a full suite of personal and business services—including solar, residential, commercial, ESOP Banking, Structured Finance and SBA loans—all designed to power a better future. We’re proud to be a Certified B Corporation, a member of 1% for the Planet, and part of the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV), reflecting our deep commitment to sustainability, transparency, and ethical banking.

With branches in St. Petersburg, Winter Park, Mount Dora , and a growing digital presence , we’re proving that banking can be a force for good. We don’t just support environmental and social causes—we’re built on them.

Under our Holding Company, Climate First Bancorp , we are also powered by OneEthos. OneEthos operates at the intersection of fintech and traditional banking to expand access to inclusive, values-driven financial services. Regulated by the Federal Reserve Bank, it equips Community Banks, Credit Unions, CDFIs, and Green Banks with ethical lending tools—especially in climate finance and solar lending.

Join the Movement

We’re seeking driven, mission-aligned individuals ready to make an impact. If you’re passionate about sustainability, thrive in a fast-paced, results driven environment, and want to be part of something bigger, you will feel right at home.

Our team is one of goal-setters, go-getters, problem solvers, thought leaders, and changemakers . We celebrate wins, tackle challenges head-on, and push boundaries. Fueled by purpose, we thrive where perseverance and passion turn ambitious goals into reality.

Thrive at Climate First Bank

At Climate First Bank , we’re investing in your future. We offer a comprehensive, people-first benefits package that supports your health, finances, and work-life balance. Please note that benefit eligibility varies by employment status and that benefits for part-time employees may differ from those listed below.

Compensation — In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for an annual bonus, incentives and equity. Actual compensation is based on industry salary ranges, internal salary structures, experience, skills and other job-related factors.

Health Coverage — 100% employer-paid for employees; employer contribution for dependents by Us

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Free Telemedicine access via Teladoc

Financial Wellness & Wealth Building

•
401(k) with 6% Employer Match — No Vesting Period.

• Employee Stock Options

• Exclusive Employee Banking Perks

• 0% Financing for Employee Solar Loans

•
Employee Only Mortgage Product with exclusive interest rates and terms.

• 0% Financing for Eligible Electric Vehicles (EVs)

• Referral Incentives

Generous Paid Time Off

•
2–4 Weeks of Vacation based on officer level plus additional tenure-based time.

•
64 Hours of Paid Sick Time for all full-time employees.

Protection & Peace of Mind

• Company-Paid Life Insurance

• Short- & Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Voluntary Life, Accident & Critical Illness Coverage

•
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free counseling, legal, and financial services.

What to expect as a Senior Manager, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing

As Senior Manager, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing, you will build and run an always-on engine for lead conversion, cross-sell, retention, and relationship growth across Climate First Bancorp, Climate First Bank , OneEthos, and future portfolio companies. You will map prospect and customer journeys, identify the next best action or product, and turn customer signals into relevant email, SMS, nurture, onboarding, engagement, and retention programs. Working across Marketing, business lines, Operations, Data, Technology, and Compliance, you will help move customers from a single product into broader relationships - increasing products per customer, deposits, lending relationships, retention, and lifetime value.

What You’ll Contribute in This Role:

•
CRM & Lifecycle Strategy - Develop the enterprise CRM and lifecycle roadmap across prospecting, lead nurture, onboarding, engagement, cross-sell, retention, reactivation, and advocacy. Define priority audiences, moments, channels, value exchanges, and KPIs based on customer needs and business opportunity.

•
Journey Design & Lead Conversion - Map end-to-end prospect and customer journeys, identify friction and communication gaps, and build triggered programs that move people toward the next meaningful action. Improve lead conversion by aligning messages, timing, sales follow-up, and handoffs across Marketing and the business lines.

•
Cross-Sell & Relationship Growth - Use product ownership, behavior, life stage, engagement, and eligibility signals to identify relevant next-best-product opportunities. Build coordinated cross-sell programs that deepen relationships without overwhelming customers or sacrificing trust, suitability, or customer experience.

•
Campaign Build, Deployment & Channel Operations - Plan, build (in collaboration with Creative Director and Creative Designer), quality-check, deploy, and optimize email, SMS, nurture, onboarding, engagement, and retention campaigns. Own briefs, audience requirements, workflow logic, testing, approvals, scheduling, suppression rules, and deployment discipline while partnering with Creative on content and assets.

•
Segmentation, Personalization & Data Stewardship - Develop actionable segments and personalization logic using customer, product, behavioral, and engagement data. Maintain strong audience, list, preference, consent, and suppression practices; partner with Data and Technology to improve data quality, availability, and responsible use.

•
Testing, Measurement & Technology Partnership - Establish lifecycle KPIs and testing roadmaps; measure conversion, engagement, product penetration, cross-sell, retention, and lifetime value. Translate results into action and partner with Marketing Operations, Salesforce owners, Technology, and Analytics on platform capabilities, integrations, tracking, and reporting.

•
Mission, Privacy & Compliance - Design communications that are relevant, transparent, and consistent with our values. Follow bank policies and requirements governing privacy, consent, preferences, disclosures, fair lending, data security, and marketing approvals; collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, IT, and business partners so programs are accurate, supportable, and responsibly executed.

What You’ll Leverage in this Role:

•
Experience & Education - You have 5+ years of progressive experience in CRM, lifecycle, retention, loyalty, marketing automation, or customer growth, including ownership of complex multichannel programs. You have a bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.

•
Lifecycle Strategy & Journey Orchestration - You have designed customer journeys and always-on programs spanning lead nurture, onboarding, engagement, cross-sell, retention, and reactivation. You understand how timing, sequence, channel, message, and human follow-up combine to move customers forward.

•
CRM & Marketing Automation Expertise - You bring strong hands-on proficiency with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or a comparable enterprise platform, including journey building, automation, audience selection, dynamic content, testing, quality assurance, scheduling, and deployment. Salesforce ecosystem experience is strongly preferred.

•
Email, SMS & Deliverability Knowledge - You understand email and SMS best practices, consent and preference management, deliverability, reputation, frequency, suppression, accessibility, and responsive design. You can balance commercial goals with customer relevance and channel health.

•
Data, Segmentation & Personalization Acumen - You are comfortable working with customer, product, behavioral, and engagement data to define audiences and triggers. You understand data models, audience logic, and data quality; familiarity with SQL or similar query tools is valued but not required.

•
Cross-Sell & Financial-Services Orientation - You understand how to deepen customer relationships through relevant next-best-product recommendations, not indiscriminate promotion. Banking, fintech, deposits, lending, or regulated-industry experience is strongly valued, along with an appreciation for suitability, trust, and long-term relationship value.

•
Measurement & Experimentation - You define clear KPIs, build disciplined tests, and connect campaign engagement to conversion, product penetration, retention, and lifetime value. You can diagnose funnel performance and turn complex results into practical recommendations for senior leaders and partners.

•
Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution - You are a strategic, technically fluent operator who can align Marketing, business lines, Technology, Data, Operations, Creative, and Compliance. You create clarity in ambiguity, manage multiple journeys and stakeholders, and maintain rigorous attention to detail from strategy through deployment.

How We Work Together at Climate First Bank

At Climate First Bank , we believe that how we work is just as important as what we do. Every team member is expected to deliver high-quality results on time—whether independently or in collaboration with others. You’ll be part of a supportive, mission-driven team where professionalism, communication, and collaboration are key to our collective success.

You’ll also be expected to stay informed and compliant with all regulatory policies, including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC. These aren’t just checkboxes — they’re essential to maintaining the trust and integrity that define our bank.

What to Expect in Your Work Environment:

This role is remote within the State of Florida, ideally local to Central Florida. On site travel within the US may be required for company events and leadership sessions. It requires the ability to perform essential functions such as sitting, talking, hearing, and occasionally lifting up to 20 lbs. We’re committed to supporting our team, and reasonable accommodation will always be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Pay Transparency:

The base pay for this role starts at $130,000 and is commensurate based on experience required in the role.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

At Climate First Bank we truly believe that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our workforce are directly linked to our success. Diversity and inclusion are at the core of our values and mission. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. In accordance with applicable law, we make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as any mental health or physical disability needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

E-Verify Statement: This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9

title: Product Design Manager
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Design leadership to match.

Our users are maintenance technicians, reliability engineers, and operations managers working on factory floors, in processing plants, and across distributed facilities. We're looking for a Product Design Manager to lead a team of product designers who make these complex, high-stakes workflows simple, intuitive, and increasingly AI-powered. You'll set creative direction across your team's product areas, grow designers at different stages of their careers, and partner deeply with Product and Engineering to ensure design is shaping outcomes, not just shipping screens. In this role, you'll be close to the work, close to the people, and accountable for both.

What You'll Do

•

Own design quality across your team's product areas for web and mobile. Guide designers through ambiguity, review work with a sharp eye, and ensure what ships is grounded in real user needs and built to a high standard.

•

Lead and grow a team of 4-6 product designers. Run 1:1s, drive career growth, deliver clear feedback, and build a team culture where people do their best work. You'll be responsible for hiring, performance, and developing the next generation of design talent at MaintainX.

•

Translate product strategy into focused design execution. Help your team understand not just what they're building, but why it matters. Set a clear, directional vision for your team's focus, rooted in customer understanding and business context.

•

Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering leads. Align on priorities, unblock delivery, and advocate for design quality and user needs in every conversation.

•

Raise the craft bar. Contribute to design critiques, invest in our design system, and ensure consistency and coherence across the experiences your team touches.

•

Lead your team in adopting AI tools and practices to accelerate design work and push the quality and speed of your team's output.

About You

•

6+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms. You've shipped complex, multi-surface work and you know what good looks like because you've done it yourself.

•

1–3 years of experience managing product designers. Running 1:1s, giving feedback that changes the work, navigating performance conversations, and helping people grow. You chose management because you're energized by making others better.

•

Strong product thinking and craft judgment. You understand customer problems, business tradeoffs, and how to connect design work to strategy. You don't simplify by removing; you simplify by clarifying.

•

You build trust through how you show up. Consistent, direct, and accountable. You create clarity for your team, resolve friction with partners early, and lead with enough confidence to make decisions and enough humility to change your mind.

•

You care about AI-powered product experiences, both in how your team designs for AI-first workflows and in how they use AI tools to push the quality and speed of their own work.

•

An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

Nice to Have

•

Experience with frontline, mobile-first, or offline-capable product design

•

Background in industrial, operations, or maintenance-adjacent domains

•

Experience contributing to or scaling a design system

•

Familiarity with designing for AI-powered workflows and data-rich interfaces

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Enterprise Account Director - North East
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

We're currently looking for an Account Director to close and manage our Enterprise accounts at MaintainX.This role is unique and different from almost anything else currently available in the market as you will have full ownership and accountability within a defined market at MaintainX. While you will have numerous resources to ensure your success, you will be completely full-cycle: from prospecting, discovery, demo, to signature.

Reporting directly to a Director of Enterprise Sales, and with high visibility across the team, this is a difference-making, meaningful, high-responsibility role. We expect the right candidate to be someone who thinks outside the box, thrives under pressure, and is laser-focused on meeting targets every single month.

What you’ll do:

•

New Logo Sales – Own new-logo enterprise growth across North East US territory, closing complex, multi-site deals from first conversation through signature.

•

Prospecting – While you will be provided a healthy amount of leads from other sources (such as marketing and the BDR team), our plan requires some pipeline contribution from self outbound prospecting efforts. Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted prospecting, executive outreach, partner signals, and coordinated campaigns with BDR and Marketing.

•

Lead Conversion – You will be “handed” warm leads on a regular basis and will need to become elite at nurturing those leads from sales cycle to close.

•

Presentation – You will be responsible for presentations, such as discovery calls, high-level product demonstrations, and closing calls.

•

Forecast – You will be expected to accurately forecast monthly and quarterly sales with +/- 15% accuracy.

•

Systems – We’re a tech company, so we provide you great technology to do your job. You will become a master of using systems like Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and others.

•

Sell to operational and executive buyers — including COOs, VP Operations, Reliability, Engineering, and Maintenance leaders — using the language of uptime, OEE, MTTR, safety, and asset performance.

•

Lead full-cycle enterprise sales motions, including discovery, business-case development, multi-threading, stakeholder alignment, procurement, negotiation, and close.

•

Build territory plans that prioritize the right accounts, industries, and expansion opportunities across the region.

•

Navigate 6–12+ stakeholder buying committees and maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and mutual action plans.

About you:

•

B2B sales experience.

•

7+ years of enterprise B2B software closing experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle sales into large, complex organizations.

•

Documented success as a closer. Ability to articulate metrics and data.

•

Willingness to prospect and contribute to your own pipeline. Whatever it takes.

•

Experience conducting your own discovery calls and product demonstrations.

•

Experience selling into manufacturing, industrials, energy, utilities, facilities, logistics, or other asset-intensive environments.

•

Comfortable moving fast, multi-tasking, and keeping the energy high.

•

Outstanding verbal and written communication ability.

•

Insanely detail-oriented and organized.

•

Personality traits: positive, passionate, creative, smart, high-character.

•

BA degree or higher.

Bonus if you have:

•

Experience with modern sales tech stacks: Salesforce, Salesloft, DiscoverOrg, etc.

•

Experience with startups and entrepreneurial organizations.

•

Experience working in CMMS or facility operations software.

•

Documented success working in a remote setting.

What’s in it for you:

•

Competitive salary and meaningful equity opportunities.

•

Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.

•

401(k) / RRSP program.

•

Take what you need PTO.

•

A Work Culture where:

•

You’ll work alongside folks across the globe that reflect the MaintainX values, Smart Humble Optimist

•

We believe in meritocracy, where ideas and effort are publicly celebrated

title: Mexico Major AE
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Enterprise sales team is responsible for revenue growth in new and existing customers that represent the largest prospective accounts for Samsara by total addressable opportunity.

This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts.

• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.

• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions

• Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships

• Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting

• Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast paced environment

• Mexico citizen

• Fluency in both Spanish and English

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)

• Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)

• Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Germany, France, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.

• You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

• You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

• Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin

• Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles

• 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

• Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales

• Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written

• Curious and able to ask insightful questions

• A champion of a Growth Mindset

• Highly proficient in English and in German

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience in closing-sales roles

• Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

• Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment

• Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways

• Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Headquarters: Texas

URL: https://kyro.ai

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours
Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role
Employment type: Full-time
Reports to: Product Manager - Growth

ABOUT KYRO AI
When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company.

https://kyro.ai/

WHY JOIN KYRO
- Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant.
- A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification.
- Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how.
- Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap.
- Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive.
- Flexibility: fully remote team.

THE ROLE
As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions:

Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team.

Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.
- Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step.
- Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold.
- Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking.
- Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

We’re excited to hire someone based in London , where we’re looking to grow our sales presence.

About The Role

Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

At most companies, Sales Engineers are the technical sidekicks to sellers. At RevenueCat, in many cases, Sales Engineers are the sellers - the first touch for most inbound conversations, the ones helping prospects understand whether RevenueCat is right for them, and the people guiding them from curiosity to implementation.

As a Senior Sales Engineer, you’ll combine deep RevenueCat product knowledge with a consultative mindset. You’ll understand app monetization models, subscription infrastructure, and the growth levers that drive success. You’ll build and demo real examples - like replicating a prospect’s paywall in our builder - while explaining how our SDKs, APIs, and integrations fit (or replace) what they already have. When larger, complex deals involve multiple stakeholders or extended commercial negotiations, you’ll partner with a Strategic Account Manager, but for most, you’ll own the full technical and commercial conversation.

If you love combining technical depth, customer empathy, and a bit of marketing insight to help developers and app teams ship faster and smarter, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Technical Discovery and Solutioning

You’ll lead discovery calls and demos that bridge technical and business needs, exploring how RevenueCat’s SDKs, APIs, and growth tools integrate with existing systems. You’ll diagnose current setups, identify opportunities to simplify or improve, and occasionally build light proof-of-concepts - such as replicating a prospect’s paywall - to make the vision concrete. The goal is to help prospects make an informed decision, not to push a contract.

Customer-Centric Guidance

You’ll manage inbound conversations from first touch through technical validation, ensuring prospects get fast, honest, and actionable advice. You’ll balance what’s possible with what’s right, steering prospects toward the best path - whether that means a quick implementation, a longer evaluation, or sometimes deciding RevenueCat isn’t the right fit yet.

Scaling Evaluation Enablement

You’ll collaborate with developer and growth advocates to turn recurring questions into scalable content: short videos, walkthroughs, and sample apps that help thousands of developers self-evaluate RevenueCat. Eventually, you’ll maintain demo environments and internal resources that make it easier for the broader Sales, Success, and Support teams to work confidently with prospects.

Collaboration and Feedback Loops

You’ll act as the bridge between customers and our internal teams - sharing product feedback, surfacing common technical hurdles, and helping shape new features. As we’re gearing up to launch more standalone product experiences, this part of the role is absolutely critical: We’ll need your input to make sure that we’re building things that prospects actually need. You’ll work with Product Marketing and Growth to produce solution guides and launch materials that reduce friction in evaluations and accelerate time to first value.

Impact and Continuous Improvement

You’ll track and analyze the evaluation funnel: how fast prospects reach a decision, what slows them down, and how your involvement moves the needle. Your success isn’t measured in contracts signed, but in time-to-value reduced and new customers confidently shipping RevenueCat in production.

What Success Looks Like

Within 1 Month

You’ve ramped up on RevenueCat SDKs, APIs, and common integration patterns. After shadowing discovery calls, you deliver your first solo demo and contribute a small improvement, such as a new sample paywall or internal guide.

Within 3 Months

You’re managing the technical side of inbound deals end-to-end. You’ve launched your first one-to-many enablement asset and built a repeatable outreach or follow-up workflow that’s driving engagement. You confidently join forces with a Strategic Account Manager to help some of the world’s biggest apps evaluate RevenueCat.

Within 6 Months

Evaluation cycles in your pipeline are consistently shorter. You have published or updated at least two sample apps or integration guides and co‑hosted our bi-weekly office hours livestream or a public webinar with Marketing. You thoroughly understand the RevenueCat platform.

After 12 Months

You are the go‑to technical resource for complex, high‑value prospects. Conversion from form fill to win has increased in the segments you have owned. You mentor new Sales Engineers and contribute to scaling our enablement library.

What You Will Need to Be Successful

•

5 or more years in a customer-facing technical role such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, or developer advocacy for a SaaS or developer-tool company

•

Fluency with mobile stacks and comfort reading and writing Swift or Objective-C, Kotlin or Java, Flutter or Dart, or React Native with TypeScript

•

Strong communication skills that connect APIs and SDKs to business impact for both developers and non-technical stakeholders

•

Curiosity about how apps acquire, convert, and retain users and the ability to have an informed conversation about monetization

•

Organizational habits that keep multiple deals, demos, and content projects on track in a remote, async environment

•

A bias toward action : you’d rather ship a 70% solution today than a perfect one next quarter

Ideally, you also

•

Have shipped or integrated an app with RevenueCat

•

Have supported or closed enterprise SaaS deals and know how to navigate complex stakeholders

•

Understand subscription commerce, in-app purchases, or payments

•

Enjoy occasional whimsical side quests like creating a demo app that turns cat photos into subscription revenue

•

Are comfortable with tools such as Linear, Notion, Slack, Salesforce, and Looker

What we offer:

•

Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

•

10-year window to exercise vested equity options

•

A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility.

•

4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

•

Paid desk at a co-working space

•

Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

•

How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

•

The values that guide how we work: Our Values

•

How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

•

What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

•

What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

description:
Wir bieten Ihnen
ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielseitigen Aufgabenbereichen im Bereich unserer Weiterbildungsplattform, der DGNB Akademie:
Vorbereitung und Betreuung von Veranstaltungen (in Präsenz, digital oder On-Demand Angebote)
Unterstützung in der Gestaltung und Qualitätssicherung von Schulungsunterlagen (PowerPoint-, Text-, sowie Video-Content) sowie Abstimmung mit DGNB Trainern bzgl. Inhalten der Schulungsangebote
Verwaltung, Erfassung und Bearbeitung der Daten von den DGNB Zertifizierungsexperten über das CRM System
Unterstützung in der Auswahl und Vorbereitung von Veranstaltungslocations
Begleitung und Nachbereitung der Prüfungen über die DGNB Hochschulpartner zu den Grundlagen des nachhaltigen Bauens
Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und Beratung
Je nach Eignung Schwerpunktsetzung in unterschiedlichen Bereichen möglich
Das bringen Sie mit
Sie sind immatrikulierter Student oder immatrikulierte Studentin der Fachrichtung Erwachsenenbildung, Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement, Medienbildung, Betriebswirtschaft bzw. Architektur oder Bauingenieurwesen oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang. Idealerweise verfügen Sie über erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Veranstaltungsmanagement oder Erwachsenenbildung.
Darüber hinaus sind Sie
motiviert, im Kundenkontakt zu sein und mit den DGNB Trainern in Kontakt zu sein
interessiert an den Fort- und Weiterbildungsangeboten zum nachhaltigen Bauen und nachhaltigen Immobilienmanagement
sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen
bereit, sich in CRM-, Prüfungssoftware und MS Office-Tools (Forms, Planner) einzuarbeiten oder bringen erste Erfahrungen mit
in der Lage, sich schnell in neue Sachverhalte einzuarbeiten
gut organisiert, zuverlässig und Sie schätzen es, selbstständig zu arbeiten
Freuen Sie sich auf
Sie haben Lust, gemeinsam mit uns die Erfolgsgeschichte des nachhaltigen Bauens weiterzuschreiben und die Transformation aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann sind Sie bei der DGNB genau richtig! Werden Sie Teil unseres vielfältigen, hochmotivierten Teams. Uns alle eint der Wunsch, mit der eigenen Arbeit einen Beitrag zu einer besseren Welt zu leisten. Die DGNB bietet hierfür das perfekte Umfeld:
große und spannende Themen- und Aufgabenvielfalt
gemeinsame Events
moderne Räumlichkeiten in einem DGNB zertifizierten Gebäude mit in der City
Arbeit in Remote ebenfalls möglich
Interessiert?
Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über unsere online Karriereseite . Gerne steht Ihnen Marianna Sip unter der Telefonnummer +49 711 722322-41 für Rückfragen zur Verfügung.

title: Account Executive | Automotive - Enterprise SaaS
description:
Intro
Every industrial company on our customer list, ZF, Schaeffler, Miele, Maersk, Lufthansa, is fighting the same challenge: margin erosion from tariffs, CBAM, and supply chains nobody fully understands anymore. We're not another SaaS tool competing for budget. We're the difference between a board that knows its cost exposure and one that finds out the hard way. As Account Executive, you own that conversation end to end, first call to signed contract, for the deals that actually move the needle.
Why this seat is different
The deals are long-cycle, technical, and multi-stakeholder, procurement, sustainability, and operations all in the room, often with conflicting priorities. If you've sold complex B2B SaaS where the win depends on translating technical value into board-level urgency, this is that seat, at a stage early enough that you'll shape how we do it, not just execute a playbook someone else wrote.
Your tasks
Own the entire sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, negotiation, close
Build and run your own outbound strategy across LinkedIn, phone, email, and your own network
Lead demos and presentations that translate technical product value into business urgency for enterprise buyers
Navigate multi-stakeholder enterprise deals (procurement, sustainability, technical) without losing momentum
Keep your pipeline clean and current in our CRM
Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to keep what we sell aligned with what we can deliver
Bring market and competitor intel back to the team to sharpen our positioning
Your profile
Proven track record running full-cycle enterprise B2B SaaS sales , with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone
Comfortable managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with technical and non-technical buyers
Experience selling into industrial or regulated sectors ( automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, logistics, chemicals) is a strong plus; we're equally interested in strong operators from adjacent complex B2B environments
Fluent in German and English ; most of our enterprise buyers are German-speaking
Hands-on CRM experience (Salesforce or HubSpot)
Based in or willing to relocate to Munich , in-person presence 3 days/week , with regular travel to customers
Benefits
Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A hybrid setup with 3 days/week in our Munich office. Real collaboration time with the team, plus the flexibility to structure the rest of your week where you focus best.
Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

As (Senior) Key Account Manager , you're not managing accounts, you're the person automotive leaders call when the choice is protect the margin or lose it. You'll build that trust directly with our CEO and sales leadership, from day one.
What you'll actually do
You'll spend most of your time deepening relationships with existing enterprise accounts (expansion, new use cases, renewals), while opening a smaller number of new strategic accounts in automotive and adjacent supplier industries.
Your tasks
Own a portfolio of existing automotive enterprise accounts , driving expansion and deepening our footprint
Identify, develop, and close new strategic accounts in automotive and adjacent supplier industries
Build multi-threaded relationships across sustainability , procurement , and operations stakeholders at large OEMs and Tier 1/2 suppliers
Translate our platform into concrete value for automotive-specific challenges : supply chain redesign, cost reduction, margin protection
Run a consultative, value-based sales process (MEDDIC or SPICED) rather than a feature-led pitch
Partner closely with our Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure accounts are set up to renew and expand
Be a thought partner on how outcome-based and AI-driven selling layers on top of traditional SaaS sales
Your profile
3+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or key account management , with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone
Experience selling into automotive OEMs or Tier 1/2 suppliers, and fluency in the transformation challenges the industry is facing
Background from a PLM, enterprise software, or value-based SaaS environment, ideally with automotive or industrial manufacturing exposure
Prior startup or high-growth company experience: you know what it's like to build process, not just execute it
Proven quota attainment and a track record of growing existing accounts , not just closing new ones
Fluent German and English
Based in or willing to relocate to Munich: this role requires in-person presence (3 days x week) with the team and close collaboration with customer-facing colleagues.
Benefits
Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A hybrid setup with 3 days/week in our Munich office. Real collaboration time with the team, plus the flexibility to structure the rest of your week where you focus best.
Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services, New York/Northeast
description:
Level: ES2-ES5
Hiring Manager:
Recruiter: Celine Clark
At Qualtrics , we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
Enterprise Account Executive – Financial Services
Why We Have This Role
Our Enterprise Account Executive team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across the world’s leading financial institutions. In the modern Financial Services sector—spanning retail banking, wealth management, commercial banking, insurance, and fintech—digital transformation, client retention, regulatory compliance, omnichannel service, and advisor/employee experience are top priorities. Our SaaS platform empowers global financial institutions to capture real-time customer feedback, elevate digital and branch interactions, and drive action with pre-built Experience Management (XM) programs.
How You’ll Find Success
Takes Initiative: Understands the expected outcome, grasps complex financial service ecosystems, and works entrepreneurially to execute.
Domain & Industry Acumen: Deep understanding of key business drivers, metrics, and buyer personas in Financial Services (e.g., Net Promoter Score/CSAT, customer churn prevention, digital adoption, wealth advisor retention, branch experience, and client lifetime value).
Proven Deal Closer: Strong track record of consistently exceeding quota and acquiring high-value enterprise financial accounts.
Complex Solution Selling: Ability to sell a multi-solution, enterprise-grade SaaS platform (Qualtrics Experience Management) into large, matrixed financial institutions with complex governance and security requirements.
Strategic Negotiation: Skilled in navigating strict procurement procedures, vendor risk management (VRM) assessments, regulatory compliance evaluations, and enterprise contract negotiations.
How You'll Grow
Structured, 100% performance-based promotion pathway.
Dedicated Career Action Planning alongside your leadership team.
Internal mobility opportunities (Qmobility) across global teams and territories.
Things You’ll Do
Quarterback strategic enterprise deals with Fortune 500 banks, wealth management firms, insurance carriers, and fintech leaders in your territory.
Consistently hit and exceed quarterly and annual revenue quotas.
Cultivate C-level and VP-level relationships across Consumer Banking, Wealth & Asset Management, Digital Transformation, Customer Experience (CX), Operations, and Human Resources.
Develop and maintain deep domain knowledge of Qualtrics’ XM offerings and how they solve financial services challenges (e.g., digital banking feedback loops, branch customer satisfaction, advisor onboarding/retention, insurance claims experience, and Voice of the Customer).
Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to build win-based proposals and strategic pricing models.
Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, SME Leads, and Customer Success) to orchestrate collaborative, high-impact enterprise sales cycles.
What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results.
5–10+ years of direct enterprise SaaS sales experience, preferably targeting Banking, Financial Services, Insurance (BFSI), or Fintech sectors.
Bachelor’s degree or higher required.
Demonstrated mastery of the MEDDPICC / MEDDIC sales process.
Strong proficiency in Salesforce.com and sales forecasting hygiene.
Experience developing complex business cases and ROI models focused on account retention, digital adoption, risk mitigation, and client lifetime value.
Proven track record of navigating long, complex contract negotiations with highly regulated financial enterprises.
Ability to travel up to 50% as needed for key client meetings, executive briefings, and industry summits.
What You Should Know About This Team
Dedicated to Financial Sector Demand: Meeting surging demand from enterprise financial leaders who are modernizing their institutions to transform client, policyholder, and employee engagement.
Strategic & Collaborative Team: Goal-oriented, high-energy group that collaborates closely to navigate complex security and procurement cycles to win market leadership.
Focused on Growth & Trust: Driven by an overarching objective to generate exponential revenue growth by empowering financial leaders to deliver exceptional, trust-building experiences across every channel.
Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
Competitive Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Performance Accelerators.
Merit-Based Growth: 100% performance-based promotions—driven by results, not politics or tenure.
Culture: A vibrant, inclusive work environment—wear jeans and bring your dog to the office anytime.
Team & Swag: Quarterly team outings, winter and summer parties, and exclusive team swag.
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private health insurance, wellness stipend, and rich mental/physical health benefits.
Qualtrics Experience Bonus: An annual cash bonus designed specifically for you to fund a personal dream experience—whether that’s a dream vacation, attending a major event, or personal passion projects.
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote
Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act
Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.
Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.
For full-time positions , this pay range is for base per year; however, base pay offered within this range may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, education, skills, and experience. A sign-on bonus and restricted stock units may be included in an employment offer. Full-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability, 401(k) with match, paid time off, a wellness reimbursement, mental health benefits, and an experience bonus. For a detailed look at our benefits, visit Qualtrics US Benefits .
Remote Base Annual Pay Transparency Range
$98,500—$187,000 USD

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Marketing and Sales Administrator

Compensation range: $1,500 AUD - $2,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, youâll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our company is a thriving real estate agency in Brisbaneâs south-west, with a principal who lists and sells at a strong pace, an in-house finance broker, and a loyal local client base built over many years. Appraisal requests are coming in fast, and the agency is ready to add a sharp, organised operator to keep every lead warm and every opportunity moving.

Role Overview: Youâll sit at the centre of the agencyâs growth engine. Youâll own a database of 30,000+ contacts, keep it clean and organised, and run a consistent nurture program so past clients, buyers and potential sellers hear from us at the right time. Youâll be on the phones connecting with homeowners, qualifying appraisal leads and booking them in for the principal. Youâll also support marketing and bring practical AI and automation skills that make every follow-up faster and more reliable.

Key Responsibilities:Â

Database & CRM ownership

• Clean, de-duplicate, update and segment approx. 25,000 existing contacts plus 5,000â10,000 newer buyer and seller contacts.
• Run a structured 6â12 month nurture cadence so every contact receives timely, relevant touchpoints.
• Log every call, email and outcome accurately so the CRM stays the single source of truth.

Phones & lead nurturing

• Make value-led outbound calls: just listed, just sold, upcoming auctions in the street, and free market report offers.
• Nurture appraisal leads, qualify their timing and motivation, and book appraisals directly into the principalâs calendar.
• Hand over warm, ready-to-list clients with clear notes, and refer finance opportunities to the in-house broker.

Marketing support

• Build and send email and SMS campaigns to targeted database segments.
• Prepare market updates and suburb reports that give homeowners genuine value.
• Support social media content and scheduling alongside the agencyâs existing marketing.

AI & automation

• Set up automated follow-ups across SMS, email and CRM workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, or built-in CRM automation.
• Monitor automations for accuracy and tone, and refine them to lift response and booking rates.

Additional sales administration

• Prepare sale contracts using approved templates and instructions; enter details, coordinate signing and distribute completed copies to relevant parties.Â
• Prepare and process Form 6 appointment documents; check details and signatures, follow up outstanding items and file completed records, subject to principal review.

Reception and general administration coverÂ

• When the receptionist is away, answer and direct calls, respond to general enquiries, record messages, manage appointments and assist with routine administrative tasks.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• 2-3+ years in a sales admin, marketing admin or client-facing role, ideally within Australian real estate.
• Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, confident phone manner that Australian homeowners respond to.
• Hands-on CRM experience and a genuine love of clean, well-organised data.
• Comfortable making outbound calls daily and energised by booking results.
• Confident using AI tools and automation platforms to work smarter.
• Self-directed and output-focused: you plan your day, deliver consistently and report progress proactively.

Bonus Skills:

• Australian real estate CRMs such as Rex, VaultRE, AgentBox or Box+Dice.
• Email marketing platforms, Canva, and social scheduling tools.
• Familiarity with Australian property terms: appraisals, auctions, listings, settlements.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

• Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
• Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as âIndependent Contractorâ)
