title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About Carrot :

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

• Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability

• Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company

• Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization

• Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics

• Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly

• Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests

• Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource

• Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

• A Bachelor's Degree

• Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions

• Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences

• Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions

• Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data

• Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments

• Experience in a high-growth environment

• Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)

• Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

• Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes

• Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes

• Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Als Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager bist du für die Preis- und Werbestrategie deiner Produktfamilien über nationale und internationale Marken hinweg verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Marketing und weiteren Teams entwickelst du E-Commerce-Strategien, die Umsätze, Wachstum und Marktanteile steigern. Du analysierst Wettbewerber sowie Markttrends und optimierst die Positionierung von Produkten, Preisen und Angeboten.

Du arbeitest an strategisch wichtigen Marken und Produktlinien mit hoher Sichtbarkeit im Management sowie ehrgeizigen Wachstumszielen und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommerz- und Preisstrategie voran.

Aufgabenbereich

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Online Pricing- und Promotion-Strategien zur Steigerung von Umsatz, Profitabilität, Neukundengewinnung und Marktanteilen.

• Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Preisanalysen sowie Aufbau und Pflege von Benchmarks zur Bewertung unserer Produkt- und Preispositionierung.

• Planung, Umsetzung und Erfolgsmessung von Pricing- und Promotion-Kampagnen über verschiedene Kanäle.

• Entwicklung und Steuerung von Pricing-Roadmaps im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.

• Analyse relevanter Commercial Performance-Kennzahlen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen bei Abweichungen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Marketing, Sales und weiteren Teams.

• Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Angebote und Kommunikation sowie Beobachtung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen.

Qualifikationen

• Bachelorabschluss in BWL, VWL, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

• 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Pricing, Marketing oder Product Management, idealerweise im Online-, IT-/Technologieumfeld.

• Sehr gute analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Daten.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen parallel zu steuern.

• Fließende Englisch- sowie und Deutschkenntnisse, Französisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus.

• Erfahrung und starkes Interesse an der Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, z. B. der Einsatz von Generativer KI zur Synthese von Marktanalysen und für die Datenmodellierung.

• Neugierige, offene und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Interesse an einem dynamischen Umfeld.

• Strukturierte, organisierte und hands-on Arbeitsweise mit gutem Priorisierungsvermögen

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

Benefits

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

• An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.

• Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.

• Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.

• Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.

• Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

• Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
description:
The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

• Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.

• Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.

• Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.

• Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.

• Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

• Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.

• Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.

• Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.

• Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

• Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.

• Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.

• Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.

• Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

• Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.

• Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.

• Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

• Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.

• Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.

• Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

• Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.

• Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.

• Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.

• Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.

• Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.

• Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.

• Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.

• Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.

• Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.

• Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.

• Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

THE ADS TEAM

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.

• Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.

• Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.

• Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.

• Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.

• First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery.

• Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).

• Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)

• A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products

• Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)

• Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations

• Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape

• Fluent in German and English

• Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills

• Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

• Reward : strong market competitive salary

• Recharge : 30 days vacation plus public holidays

• Regulate : trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

• We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market

• We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days

• We’re inclusive: ‘ Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities

• We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!

• We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals

• We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

You can learn more about us at: https://zattoo.com

title: Director of Enterprise Sales
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Kindly note this role is for the East Coast, and we are open to candidates in cities on the East Coast in the United States and Canada.

MaintainX is looking for a Director of Enterprise Sales to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading our South East enterprise sales team, driving revenue growth, and expanding our market presence. You will play a role in the strategic direction of the team, manage key customer relationships, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction and success. Your role will be pivotal in achieving our ambitious growth targets and maintaining our position as the world-leading workflow management platform.

What You’ll Do:

•

Develop and implement effective sales strategies to drive enterprise sales growth and achieve revenue targets.

•

Lead, mentor, hire, and manage a high-performing enterprise sales team to exceed sales objectives.

•

Identify and cultivate relationships with key decision-makers in target accounts to secure high-value contracts.

•

Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align sales strategies with company goals and customer needs.

•

Analyze market trends, customer feedback, and competitive landscape to inform sales strategies and identify opportunities for growth.

•

Provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and insights to senior management, ensuring transparency and accountability.

About You:

•

Proven track record of success in enterprise sales leadership roles within the SaaS industry.

•

Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

•

Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with C-level executives.

•

Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing sales team.

•

Experience with CRM software and sales analytics tools to manage and optimize sales processes.

•

A proactive, results-oriented mindset with a passion for driving business growth and achieving targets.

About us:

Our mission is to deliver one platform for maintenance, repair & operations teams to keep the physical world running. We believe the greatest asset in any organization is the people. That’s why we built an intuitive, mobile-first solution to help boost productivity and collaboration across teams and locations.

MaintainX is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Sales Manager (Crypto/Fintech/Payments)
description:
Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Their operation is fully legal and compliant, with licenses in multiple countries and jurisdictions globally. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.

Role Overview

Our client is seeking an ambitious Sales Manager to accelerate client acquisition, grow settlement volumes, and strengthen corridor activity within their Digital Assets business line. This role is hands-on and results-driven - ideal for someone with a strong network across PSPs, OTC traders, crypto exchanges, or financial institutions who can drive business volume directly into our clients network. You will own the full sales lifecycle — from prospecting and negotiation to onboarding and activation — and will play a key role in achieving the company’s TPV and revenue targets.

Job Type: Full Time

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

• 5–10 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management within fintech, FX/payments, or digital assets.

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue and volume targets.

• Strong network across OTC trading desks, PSPs, remittance firms, or exchanges.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills; able to handle complex deals independently.

• Understanding of stablecoins, FX, cross-border settlement, and liquidity management preferred.

• Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a fast-moving, execution-driven environment.

• Fluent in English (Mandarin, Thai, Tagalog, Bahasa, or other Asian languages a plus).

Responsibilities

Business Development & Revenue Growth

• Acquire new clients and partners across PSPs, OTC desks, exchanges, and remittance firms.

• Drive cross-border settlement volume and liquidity into Lightnet’s stablecoin and payment rails.

• Manage the full sales cycle: From lead generation, proposal, and negotiation to contract and onboarding.

• Meet or exceed assigned monthly and quarterly Total Payment Volume (TPV) and Net Revenue Contribution (NRC) targets.

• Identify and pursue new corridor opportunities (e.g., THB↔PHP, PHP↔IDR, CNY/CNH, SGD corridors).

Account Management & Relationship Building

• Maintain and grow relationships with key institutional clients and partners.

• Ensure successful onboarding and operational readiness with Treasury, Compliance, and Onboarding teams.

• Work closely with Product and Operations to improve partner experience and address client needs.

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

• Monitor competitive activity, partner feedback, and emerging market trends in digital assets and cross-border payments.

• Contribute to corridor strategy, pricing optimization, and market expansion initiatives.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Commercial leadership to execute go-to-market campaigns and partnership launches.

Benefits

• Competitive salary with open-ended performance-based commission.

• Opportunity to work at the forefront of fintech innovation in cross-border digital asset settlement.

• Collaborative, high-performance culture with regional career growth opportunities.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Media (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com .

Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus
Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen
Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Zur Verve Retail Media gehört seit kurzem der Couponing- und Cashback-Spezialist acardo.

Die Rolle in einem Satz
Du trägst eine Hunter-Mentalität in dir und gewinnst neue Umsätze bei FMCG-Marken, indem du integrierte Shopper Activation Kampagnen verkaufst: d.h. coupon-getriebene Conversion und messbarer Sales Lift, idealerweise erweitert um Screen-Präsenz im Markt.

Was du verkaufst

• Ein kombiniertes Produkt aus digitaler Sichtbarkeit im Markt Screens an Eingang, Fläche, Kasse), Aktivierung am Point of Sale (über Coupons) und Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten (anstatt isolierter Werbeflächen oder losgelöster Coupons)

• Kampagnen, die drei Logiken beim Kunden verbinden: Markenreichweite, Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz

• 360Grad-Aktivierung, die über den Markt hinausgeht: (Re)Targeting im CTV und weiteren Offsite-Kanälen als Verlängerung der In-Store-Kampagne

• Konkrete Beweispunkte aus Pilotprojekten: z.B. 9% Uplift auf Store-Ebene, 20% in ausgewählten Kategorien

An wen du verkaufst

• Direkt an FMCG-Marken

• Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus Brand und Media (-Planung und -Einkauf) und verwalten drei Budgettöpfe mit unterschiedlichen Zielen, Freigabelogiken und Erfolgsmetriken

Deine Aufgaben

• Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen

• Neukunden und Stakeholder (horizontal und vertikal) gewinnen und Kunden zu wiederkehrenden Partnern entwickeln

• Den kompletten Sales-Zyklus verantworten: Erstansprache, Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss. Mit Abschluss erfolgt die Übergabe ans AdOps Team

• Kundenziele in Media- und Aktivierungskonzepte übersetzen: Touchpoints, Reichweiten, Zielgruppen, Mechaniken Cashback, Gratis-Testen, Kategorie-Trigger), Messansatz

• Sales-Lift-Daten und Pilotergebnisse als Beweispunkte im Pitch einsetzen, um aus ersten Testbudgets hohe wiederkehrende Volumina zu machen

• VRM gegenüber konkurrierenden Retail-Media-Formaten klar differenzieren

• Feedback aus dem Markt in Produkt, Pitchmaterial und Go-to-Market zurückspielen

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

• Du bist ein Individual Contributor ohne Personalverantwortung

• Du berichtest direkt an die CSO

• Du verkaufst eigenständig, aber nicht allein: Media Planning entwickelt das Kampagnen-Setup, Ad Operations steuert die Auslieferung, Data Science liefert den Wirkungsnachweis

• Dein Fokus ist kommerziell: Pipeline, Abschluss, Kundentiefe, Wiederbuchung

Warum diese Rolle

Du liebst es, Dinge von Grund auf mit aufzubauen. Denn bei uns steigst du nicht in eine fertige Vermarktungsmaschine mit festem Produktkatalog ein, sondern du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf. Die Deals, die du jetzt gewinnst, werden intern und extern zu Referenzen. Sie prägen, wie Marken und Agenturen In-Store Retail Media künftig bewerten und einkaufen.

• Echte Ownership: deine Pipeline, deine Kunden, dein Umsatz

• Direkter Zugang zu CSO und CEO bei strategischen Kunden

• Ein Produkt, das mehr kann als Reichweite verkaufen: Sichtbarkeit, Aktivierung und messbare Wirkung bis zum Kauf

• AI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen

Wenn du lieber Benchmarks setzt als bestehende Playbooks abarbeitest, ist das die richtige Rolle.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com .

What We Do

At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously.

This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators!

The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web. You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work.

Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.

As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment.

If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive.

What you'll do

• Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities.

• Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow.

• Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer , you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

•

Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

•

Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

•

Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

•

Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

•

Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

•

Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

•

Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

•

Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

•

Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

•

Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

•

Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

•

Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

•

Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

•

Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

•

Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

•

Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

•

Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

•

Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

•

Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

•

Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

•

Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

•

Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

•

Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

•

8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

•

Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

•

3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

•

2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

•

Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

•

Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

•

Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

•

Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

•

Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

•

Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

•

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

•

Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

•

Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

•

Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

•

Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

•

Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

•

Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

•

Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

•

Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

•

Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

•

Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

•

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

•

Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

•

Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

•

Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

•

Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

•

Competitive base compensation

•

Annual bonus potential

•

Health benefits effective on start date

•

Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

•

401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

•

Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days

•

Company paid STD/LTD

•

Technology setup

•

Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message. Any communication received from a Vytalize Health recruiter during your screening, interviewing, or selection process will come from an email ending in @ vytalizehealth.com

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own

Email & Retention Design

• Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
• Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
• Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

Web Creative & CRO Support

• Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
• Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
• Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

Social & Ad Creative

• Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
• Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
• Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

Process & Quality

• Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
• Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
• Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
• Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
• Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

• An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
• Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
• Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
• A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
• Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
• AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
• Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

• You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
• You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
• You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
• You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
• Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:

• 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
• A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
• Advanced proficiency in Figma
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
• Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
• Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
• Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
• Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
• Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team

Strong Differentiators:

• Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
• Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
• Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
• Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
• Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
• Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

• Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
• Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST

Compensation

$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

• Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands

• Skincare and beauty

• Tech and software

• Finance and investing

• Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability

• Education

• Home improvement

• Automobiles and motorcycles

• Health and wellness

• Medical and clinical fields

• Digital marketing

• SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

• Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites

• Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy

• Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors

• Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices

• Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing

• Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications

• Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills

• 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred

• Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices

• Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics

• Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content

• Portfolio featuring published work preferred

• Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Technical Customer Support
description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

• Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.

• Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.

• Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

• Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.

• Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.

• Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

• Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.

• Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.

• Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

• Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.

• Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.

• Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

• Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.

• Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

• You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.

• You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.

• You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.

• You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.

• Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.

• You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.

• You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.

• You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.

• Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.

• Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

• Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.

• Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.

• Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.

• Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.

• An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

• Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.

• Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.

• Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.

• The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.

• The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

• Contract type: full-time or part-time

• Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).

• Start date: negotiable

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.

We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.

This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

• Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.

• Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.

• Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.

• Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.

• Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA

URL: http://bit.ly/3kLhMdk

About Contra Labs

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works

This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

•

Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

•

Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

•

Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

•

Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality

•

Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

•

Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

•

Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

•

Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

•

Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences

What We're Looking For

• Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences

•

Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence

•

Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

•

Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics

•

Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus)

title: Design Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads.

Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code.

You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch.

AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

• Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production.

• Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem.

• Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads.

• Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand
